# Core API

The Vault Core API is RESTful. It uses predictable and resource-oriented URLs with standard HTTP methods and status codes. Responses are in JSON format.

For an overview of the general features of the API, see [API intro](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/overview/).

## [](#downloading_the_openapi_definition_file "Copy link to heading")Downloading the OpenAPI definition file

The OpenAPI definition is an Interface Description Language for describing RESTful APIs expressed in JSON format.

info

The Core API is available in this format and can be downloaded here:

Download download

The specification includes Thought Machine-specific extensions that are not standard to OpenAPI. The generation method of the specification and resulting naming, paths and schemas are subject to change. For more information about the OpenAPI specification see the [OpenAPI specification](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.0.3).

## [](#account_attributes "Copy link to heading")Account Attributes

### [](#accountattributevalue "Copy link to heading")AccountAttributeValue

#### [](#available_methods "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_account_attributes_ListAccountAttributeValuesResponse_ListAccountAttributeValues) `ListAccountAttributeValues` retrieves a filtered and paginated list of [Account Attribute](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/account_attributes) values.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_account_attributes_ListAccountAttributeValuesResponse_ListAccountAttributeValues "Copy link to heading")List

`ListAccountAttributeValues` retrieves a filtered and paginated list of [Account Attribute](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/account_attributes) values. Requires filtering by account ID and attribute name. Values are calculated as of the point in time the API call is made.

For each `account_ids` value in the request, the corresponding Smart Contract’s [attribute\_hook](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/hooks#attribute_hook) is executed once for every `attribute_names` value and `effective_timestamps` value in the request. For example, a request with two Account IDs, three Attribute Names, and four Effective Timestamps values will result in 24 hook executions.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.account\_attribute\_values:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/account-attribute-values

## [](#account_schedule_tags "Copy link to heading")Account schedule tags

Account schedule tags replace [schedule tags](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#scheduleTag) for accounts and plans.

Account schedule tags can be used to modify how schedules are executed for accounts or plans. These can be useful for:

-   Testing schedules on an account or plan
    
-   Performing migrations from a previous banking system to Vault
    

For example, accounts can be loaded from a previous system with the schedules skipped. When all accounts have been migrated, all schedules can be enabled in Vault and the schedules in the previous system can be disabled.

### [](#account_schedule_tag_schedule_status_override "Copy link to heading")Account schedule tag schedule status override

**Deprecated as of release 5.5.0, and will be removed no earlier than release 7.0.0. Scheduler tag status overrides are deprecated because its use cases are no longer valid.**

An account schedule tag `schedule_status_override` field can be set to one of:

-   `ACCOUNT_SCHEDULE_TAG_SCHEDULE_STATUS_OVERRIDE_NO_OVERRIDE`
    
-   `ACCOUNT_SCHEDULE_TAG_SCHEDULE_STATUS_OVERRIDE_TO_ENABLED`
    
-   `ACCOUNT_SCHEDULE_TAG_SCHEDULE_STATUS_OVERRIDE_TO_FAST_FORWARDED`
    
-   `ACCOUNT_SCHEDULE_TAG_SCHEDULE_STATUS_OVERRIDE_TO_SKIPPED`
    

For all values except for NO\_OVERRIDE, an account schedule tag will override the status of any schedule with the same tag. For example, a `schedule_status_override` of TO\_SKIPPED will skip all schedules with this tag between the `schedule_status_override_start_timestamp` and `schedule_status_override_end_timestamp`.

### [](#accountscheduletag "Copy link to heading")AccountScheduleTag

#### [](#available_methods_2 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_account_schedule_tags_ListAccountScheduleTagsResponse_ListAccountScheduleTags) Retrieves all AccountScheduleTags.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_account_schedule_tags_AccountScheduleTag_CreateAccountScheduleTag) Creates an AccountScheduleTag.
    
-   [Update](#_core_api_v1_account_schedule_tags_AccountScheduleTag_UpdateAccountScheduleTag) Updates an AccountScheduleTag.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_account_schedule_tags_BatchGetAccountScheduleTagsResponse_BatchGetAccountScheduleTags) Retrieves one or more AccountScheduleTags based on their AccountScheduleTag IDs.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_account_schedule_tags_ListAccountScheduleTagsResponse_ListAccountScheduleTags "Copy link to heading")List

Retrieves all AccountScheduleTags.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.account\_schedule\_tags:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/account-schedule-tags

##### [](#request_2 "Copy link to heading")Request

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be listed.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 500.

 |
|

string

 | 

Token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, returns the first page of results. Optional.

 |

##### [](#response "Copy link to heading")Response

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
|

array \[object\]

 | 

A list of matching AccountScheduleTags, ordered by ascending ID.

 |
| 

account\_schedule\_tags\[\].  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the AccountScheduleTag; it is used to tag schedules in a Smart Contract or Supervisor Contract.  
  
Required.  
Max length: 256 characters.

 |
| 

account\_schedule\_tags\[\].  
**description**  
  
string

 | 

The description of the AccountScheduleTag.

 |
| 

account\_schedule\_tags\[\].  
**sends\_scheduled\_operation\_reports**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates if the AccountScheduleTag is set to produce execution notifications.

 |
| 

account\_schedule\_tags\[\].  
**schedule\_status\_override**  
  
enum

 | 

The status applied to schedules tagged with this AccountScheduleTag.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.5**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Scheduler tag status overrides are deprecated because its use cases are no longer valid.*  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_SCHEDULE\_TAG\_SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_OVERRIDE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**ACCOUNT\_SCHEDULE\_TAG\_SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_OVERRIDE\_NO\_OVERRIDE:**  
Indicates that the AccountScheduleTag is inactive; it will not apply any status effects on its tagged account/plan schedules. `schedule_status_override_start_timestamp` and `schedule_status_override_end_timestamp` must not be provided for this status override.  
**ACCOUNT\_SCHEDULE\_TAG\_SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_OVERRIDE\_TO\_ENABLED:**  
An AccountScheduleTag with this status override will temporarily override the status of all tagged schedules to `SCHEDULE_STATUS_ENABLED`. The change will be effective between `schedule_status_override_start_timestamp` and `schedule_status_override_end_timestamp`. Both `schedule_status_override_start_timestamp` and `schedule_status_override_end_timestamp` are required for this status override.  
**ACCOUNT\_SCHEDULE\_TAG\_SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_OVERRIDE\_TO\_FAST\_FORWARDED:**  
An AccountScheduleTag with this status override will temporarily fast-forward tagged account/plan schedules.  
All jobs associated with tagged schedules that have a:  
\- `schedule_timestamp` between the current time and `schedule_status_override_end_timestamp` are triggered immediately  
\- `schedule_timestamp` after `schedule_status_override_end_timestamp` are unaffected and are triggered at their `schedule_timestamp`  
  
For this status override,`schedule_status_override_start_timestamp` must not be provided, but `schedule_status_override_end_timestamp` must be provided.  
  
Note: For tags with a value in `test_pause_at_timestamp`:  
\- This schedule status override setting will prioritise the schedule status override behaviour (over the `test_pause_at_timestamp`)  
\- Any other schedule status override setting will prioritise `test_pause_at_timestamp` (over the schedule status override)  
**ACCOUNT\_SCHEDULE\_TAG\_SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_OVERRIDE\_TO\_SKIPPED:**  
An AccountScheduleTag with this status override will temporarily override the status of all tagged schedules to `SCHEDULE_STATUS_SKIPPED`. The change will be effective between `schedule_status_override_start_timestamp` and `schedule_status_override_end_timestamp`. `schedule_status_override_start_timestamp` is optional for this status override and defaults to the current time if it is not provided. `schedule_status_override_end_timestamp` is required for this status override.

 |
|

 |
|

 | 

A timestamp, in UTC, indicating when to stop overriding the status on account/plan schedules with this tag. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
|

A timestamp, in UTC, indicating when an account/plan schedule with this tag will pause; the pause will occur when `next_run_timestamp` is greater than `test_pause_at_timestamp`. Only for testing purposes. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

#### [](#_core_api_v1_account_schedule_tags_AccountScheduleTag_CreateAccountScheduleTag "Copy link to heading")Create

Creates an AccountScheduleTag. The AccountScheduleTag can be created with a status of `ACCOUNT_SCHEDULE_TAG_SCHEDULE_STATUS_OVERRIDE_NO_OVERRIDE`, `ACCOUNT_SCHEDULE_TAG_SCHEDULE_STATUS_OVERRIDE_TO_ENABLED`, `ACCOUNT_SCHEDULE_TAG_SCHEDULE_STATUS_OVERRIDE_TO_FAST_FORWARDED` or `ACCOUNT_SCHEDULE_TAG_SCHEDULE_STATUS_OVERRIDE_TO_SKIPPED`.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.account\_schedule\_tags:write

**Endpoint:** POST /v1/account-schedule-tags

## [](#accounts_version_1 "Copy link to heading")Accounts version 1

A Customer Account is an instance of a financial Product, whereas an Internal Account is used to allocate and track funds owned by the financial institution.

chat\_bubble

[Accounts version 1](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_1/) is a legacy API. Vault Core 5 introduced the [Accounts version 2](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#accounts_version_2).

### [](#account "Copy link to heading")Account

#### [](#available_methods_3 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_accounts_ListAccountsResponse_ListAccounts) Retrieves all the accounts for a customer. **(Deprecated)**
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_CreateAccount) Creates an account for a customer. **(Deprecated)**
    
-   [Update](#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount) Updates a customer’s account. **(Deprecated)**
    
-   [Get](#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_GetAccount) Retrieves a specified account of the customer. **(Deprecated)**
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_accounts_ListAccountsResponse_ListAccounts "Copy link to heading")List

**Deprecated** as of release **5.0**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0** *This method is deprecated in favour of /v2/accounts.*

Retrieves all the accounts for a customer.

info

When using this endpoint in Vault 5.0+, there will be a short interval between a mutation being made to a given Account, and that mutation being reflected in the list response. This is to allow insertion of the record into [warm storage](/vault-core/5-8/EN/environment_and_installation/infrastructure_docs/vault_cloud_infrastructure/using_a_relational_database).

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.accounts:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/accounts

##### [](#request_6 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters

 | 

The ID of the stakeholder whose accounts are to be listed. Optional.

The number of results to be listed. The Vault Core 6.0 release will reduce the maximum page size to 100.  
  
Required.

 |

 | 

Token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, returns the first page of results. Optional.

 |
| 

**account\_statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

List of inclusive OR account status filters. Must be URL encoded. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN:**  
Account has been approved and transactions are allowed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
Account was previously open but is now permanently closed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Account was requested but was never approved, it is now permanently closed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
Account was requested closure but contract and account closure are not finished.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
Account and contract record has been created, it is waiting for another call to be made open.

 |
|

array \[string\]

List of inclusive OR product version ID filters. Must be URL encoded. Optional.

 | 

The ID of the product version matching the product ID. Required for create requests if `product_id` is not provided. Product Versions that use Expected Parameter syntax are not supported; /v2/accounts must be used instead.

 |
| 

accounts\[\].  
**permitted\_denominations\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

A set of denominations accessible from within the Smart Contract:  
  
\- If the Product Version specifies supported denominations, then this set must be a subset of those (if none are specified here then the field will be set to the Product Version’s supported denominations).  
\- If the Product Version does not specify denominations, then it will be set to the permitted\_denominations defined in values.yaml  
  
The permitted\_denominations field on the account resource is not used when validating incoming posting instructions' denominations. To validate that the denominations used by incoming posting instructions are in this list, the check must be implemented in the pre\_posting\_hook of the Smart Contract of the customer account that the posting instruction is targeting. This field cannot be updated.

 |
| 

accounts\[\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the account. Optional for creation. Valid updates are from ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN or ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED, ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE or ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED, ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED. Updating the status to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN will trigger the creation of an account update with an `activation_update` field and run the contract activation code. Updating the status to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE will trigger the creation of an account update with a `closure_update` field and run the contract `deactivation_hook`. Accounts can only be updated from ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED when the `closing_timestamp` is provided, the account has a zero balance, and at least one `activation_update` account update has the status ACCOUNT\_UPDATE\_STATUS\_COMPLETED. Accounts can only be updated from ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED once the `closure_update` account update has the status ACCOUNT\_UPDATE\_STATUS\_COMPLETED and the account has a zero balance. Note that when updating the account from ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED, a `closing_timestamp` may be provided.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN:**  
Account has been approved and transactions are allowed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
Account was previously open but is now permanently closed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Account was requested but was never approved, it is now permanently closed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
Account was requested closure but contract and account closure are not finished.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
Account and contract record has been created, it is waiting for another call to be made open.

 |

#### [](#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_CreateAccount "Copy link to heading")Create

**Deprecated** as of release **5.0**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0** *This method is deprecated in favour of /v2/accounts.*

Creates an account for a customer. The account can be created with a status of OPEN or PENDING.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.accounts:write

**Endpoint:** POST /v1/accounts

Accounts can only be updated from ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED once the `closure_update` account update has the status ACCOUNT\_UPDATE\_STATUS\_COMPLETED and the account has a zero balance. \- If the Product Version specifies supported denominations, then this set must be a subset of those (if none are specified here then the field will be set to the Product Version’s supported denominations).  
\- If the Product Version does not specify denominations, then it will be set to the permitted\_denominations defined in values.yaml  
  
The permitted\_denominations field on the account resource is not used when validating incoming posting instructions' denominations. To validate that the denominations used by incoming posting instructions are in this list, the check must be implemented in the pre\_posting\_hook of the Smart Contract of the customer account that the posting instruction is targeting. This field cannot be updated.

 |
| 

**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the account. Optional for creation. Valid updates are from ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN or ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED, ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE or ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED, ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED. Updating the status to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN will trigger the creation of an account update with an `activation_update` field and run the contract activation code. Updating the status to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE will trigger the creation of an account update with a `closure_update` field and run the contract `deactivation_hook`. Accounts can only be updated from ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED when the `closing_timestamp` is provided, the account has a zero balance, and at least one `activation_update` account update has the status ACCOUNT\_UPDATE\_STATUS\_COMPLETED. Accounts can only be updated from ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED once the `closure_update` account update has the status ACCOUNT\_UPDATE\_STATUS\_COMPLETED and the account has a zero balance. Note that when updating the account from ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE to ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED, a `closing_timestamp` may be provided.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN:**  
Account has been approved and transactions are allowed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
Account was previously open but is now permanently closed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Account was requested but was never approved, it is now permanently closed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
Account was requested closure but contract and account closure are not finished.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
Account and contract record has been created, it is waiting for another call to be made open.

 |
| 

**opening\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time when the account was opened, in UTC. Optional for create. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp . If supplied during account creation, the account must be created with status ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN and the `opening_timestamp` value must not be a time in the future. The value corresponds to the `effective_datetime` hook argument when the activation hook is run.

 |
| 

**closing\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time when the account was closed, in UTC. Can be updated to a time in the past directly if the account status is updated to CLOSED in the same call. The account status must be OPEN or PENDING\_CLOSURE to update the closing timestamp. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**stakeholder\_ids\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The customer IDs that can access the account. Required for create requests.

 |
| 

**instance\_param\_vals**  
  
map \[string: string\]

 | 

The instance-level parameter name(s) and value(s) for the associated product, defined in the account’s Smart Contract code. Any `default_value` specified in the Smart Contract is not used on Account creation requests; it is only used for Account conversions performed via `v1/account-migrations`. Optional for create requests.

 |
| 

**derived\_instance\_param\_vals**  
  
map \[string: string\]

 | 

The derived instance-level parameters for the associated product that have been defined in the account’s Smart Contract code.

 |
| 

**details**  
  
map \[string: string\]

 | 

A map of unstructured fields that hold instance-specific account details, for example, the source of funds. Optional for create requests.  
  
The details must not include:  
\- Any image data, including any KYC collateral such as passport, licence or other images. These must be stored in a separate repository outside of Vault.  
\- Any data that is classified as PII data.  
The details cannot be utilised by Smart Contracts to drive any type of product behaviour.  
  
Max size: 1MB (but it is strongly recommended to keep below this size).

 |
| 

**accounting**  
  
object

 | 

The accounting data that Vault supports as first-class fields.

 |
| 

accounting.  
**tside**  
  
enum

 | 

The side of the balance sheet where the account balance is counted. Can be optionally provided when creating Internal Accounts. Has no effect if provided when creating Customer Accounts.  
  
**Enum values**  
**TSIDE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default Value, invalid.  
**TSIDE\_ASSET:**  
Debit postings increase balances for asset accounts.  
**TSIDE\_LIABILITY:**  
Credit postings increase balances for liability accounts.

#### [](#_core_api_v1_accounts_ListAccountMigrationsResponse_ListAccountMigrations "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters account migrations.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.account\_migrations:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/account-migrations

 |

**Enum values**

Default value.  
**ACCOUNT\_MIGRATION\_STATUS\_PENDING\_EXECUTION:**  
Indicates that the account migration is in progress.  
**ACCOUNT\_MIGRATION\_STATUS\_PAUSED:**  
Indicates that the account migration has been paused.  
**ACCOUNT\_MIGRATION\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Indicates that the account migration has been completed. This status implies that all of the requested Account Updates have been created and processed in Vault; it does not claim that all Updates have been successful.

 |

account\_migrations\[\].  
product\_version\_migration.  
**schedule\_migration\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Specifies how existing schedules should be migrated.  
  
Note: This field has no effect on migrations to a product version on Contracts Language API version 4.  
See [Account conversions](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_1#account_conversions).  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **4.6**, and will be removed no earlier than release **6.0**  
*This field is not used on updates to Contracts Language API version 4 and will be removed alongside Contracts Language API version 3.*  
  
**Enum values**  
**SCHEDULE\_MIGRATION\_TYPE\_RECREATE\_ALL\_SCHEDULES\_AND\_GROUPS:**  
When updating the product version of an account, all existing schedules will be disabled. New schedules will then be created according to the Smart Contract code of the new product version. Any updates previously made to existing schedules will not be preserved. This is the default behaviour.  
**SCHEDULE\_MIGRATION\_TYPE\_PRESERVE\_SCHEDULES\_IF\_NO\_GROUP\_CHANGES:**  
When updating the product version of an account, existing schedules are preserved if either: - They are not part of a group and a schedule of the same event type is defined in the new Smart Contract code; or  
\- They are part of a group and a group of the same name, size and order is defined in the new Smart Contract code. New schedules are only created if they are defined in the new Smart Contract code.

string

 | 

Token used to retrieve the next page. If empty, returns the last page of results.

product\_version\_migration.  
**schedule\_migration\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Specifies how existing schedules should be migrated.  
  
Note: This field has no effect on migrations to a product version on Contracts Language API version 4.  
See [Account conversions](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_1#account_conversions).  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **4.6**, and will be removed no earlier than release **6.0**  
*This field is not used on updates to Contracts Language API version 4 and will be removed alongside Contracts Language API version 3.*  
  
**Enum values**  
**SCHEDULE\_MIGRATION\_TYPE\_RECREATE\_ALL\_SCHEDULES\_AND\_GROUPS:**  
When updating the product version of an account, all existing schedules will be disabled. New schedules will then be created according to the Smart Contract code of the new product version. Any updates previously made to existing schedules will not be preserved. This is the default behaviour.  
**SCHEDULE\_MIGRATION\_TYPE\_PRESERVE\_SCHEDULES\_IF\_NO\_GROUP\_CHANGES:**  
When updating the product version of an account, existing schedules are preserved if either: - They are not part of a group and a schedule of the same event type is defined in the new Smart Contract code; or  
\- They are part of a group and a group of the same name, size and order is defined in the new Smart Contract code. New schedules are only created if they are defined in the new Smart Contract code.

**Note: Any `default_value` for Instance Parameters specified in the Smart Contract will only be used in Account conversions performed via `v1/account-migrations`, and only for Instance Parameters introduced in the new Smart Contract version.**

account\_update.  
product\_version\_update.  
**schedule\_migration\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Specifies how existing schedules should be migrated.  
  
Note: This field has no effect on migrations to a product version on Contracts Language API version 4.  
See [Account conversions](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_1#account_conversions).  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **4.6**, and will be removed no earlier than release **6.0**  
*This field is not used on updates to Contracts Language API version 4 and will be removed alongside Contracts Language API version 3.*  
  
**Enum values**  
**SCHEDULE\_MIGRATION\_TYPE\_RECREATE\_ALL\_SCHEDULES\_AND\_GROUPS:**  
When updating the product version of an account, all existing schedules will be disabled. New schedules will then be created according to the Smart Contract code of the new product version. Any updates previously made to existing schedules will not be preserved. This is the default behaviour.  
**SCHEDULE\_MIGRATION\_TYPE\_PRESERVE\_SCHEDULES\_IF\_NO\_GROUP\_CHANGES:**  
When updating the product version of an account, existing schedules are preserved if either: - They are not part of a group and a schedule of the same event type is defined in the new Smart Contract code; or  
\- They are part of a group and a group of the same name, size and order is defined in the new Smart Contract code. New schedules are only created if they are defined in the new Smart Contract code.  
  
**Default**  
**SCHEDULE\_MIGRATION\_TYPE\_RECREATE\_ALL\_SCHEDULES\_AND\_GROUPS**

### [](#accountupdatebatch "Copy link to heading")AccountUpdateBatch

#### [](#available_methods_9 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_accounts_ListAccountUpdateBatchesResponse_ListAccountUpdateBatches) Lists and filters account update batches.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_accounts_AccountUpdateBatch_CreateAccountUpdateBatch) Creates a batch of account updates. **(Deprecated)**
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_accounts_BatchGetAccountUpdateBatchesResponse_BatchGetAccountUpdateBatches) Retrieves one or more account update batches by account update batch ID.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_accounts_ListAccountUpdateBatchesResponse_ListAccountUpdateBatches "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters account update batches.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.account\_update\_batches:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/account-update-batches

##### [](#request_22 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**account\_migration\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of the account migrations that account update batches are to be listed for. Required; must be non-empty.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be listed. Required; must be non-zero.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 20.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, returns the first page of results. Optional.

 |

##### [](#response_21 "Copy link to heading")Response

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**account\_update\_batches\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

A list of matching account update batches, ordered by descending `create_timestamp`.

 |
| 

account\_update\_batches\[\].  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

A unique identifier for the account update batch. Optional.

 |
| 

account\_update\_batches\[\].  
**account\_updates\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

The AccountUpdates that will be created as part of this batch. The maximum number of AccountUpdates per batch is 50.

string

The product version ID of the product that the account is to be updated to. The product version ID can be for any type of product provided it supports all the denominations and has the same tside as the current product. For updates to product versions that make use of contract modules, each named contract module in the target product version must have a corresponding Smart Contract module versions link.  
  
*Note:  
\- Updating an Account to a new product version will mean that the Account can only retrieve the Template Parameter history of the new product version  
\- Product Versions that use Expected Parameter syntax are not supported; /v2/accounts must be used instead.*

map \[string: string\]

 |

**Note: Any `default_value` for Instance Parameters specified in the Smart Contract will only be used in Account conversions performed via `v1/account-migrations`, and only for Instance Parameters introduced in the new Smart Contract version.**

 |
| 

account\_update\_batches\[\].  
account\_updates\[\].  
product\_version\_update.  
**schedule\_migration\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Specifies how existing schedules should be migrated.  
  
Note: This field has no effect on migrations to a product version on Contracts Language API version 4.  
See [Account conversions](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_1#account_conversions).  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **4.6**, and will be removed no earlier than release **6.0**  
*This field is not used on updates to Contracts Language API version 4 and will be removed alongside Contracts Language API version 3.*  
  
**Enum values**  
**SCHEDULE\_MIGRATION\_TYPE\_RECREATE\_ALL\_SCHEDULES\_AND\_GROUPS:**  
When updating the product version of an account, all existing schedules will be disabled. New schedules will then be created according to the Smart Contract code of the new product version. Any updates previously made to existing schedules will not be preserved. This is the default behaviour.  
**SCHEDULE\_MIGRATION\_TYPE\_PRESERVE\_SCHEDULES\_IF\_NO\_GROUP\_CHANGES:**  
When updating the product version of an account, existing schedules are preserved if either: - They are not part of a group and a schedule of the same event type is defined in the new Smart Contract code; or  
\- They are part of a group and a group of the same name, size and order is defined in the new Smart Contract code. New schedules are only created if they are defined in the new Smart Contract code.

 |
| 

create\_options.  
**invalid\_account\_update\_handling\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Determines how invalid updates in the batch are handled.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INVALID\_ACCOUNT\_UPDATE\_HANDLING\_TYPE\_FAIL\_BATCH:**  
Default value. Returns an error if any update is invalid. No batch will be created.  
**INVALID\_ACCOUNT\_UPDATE\_HANDLING\_TYPE\_FAIL\_INVALID\_UPDATES\_ONLY:**  
Invalid updates are created with REJECTED status and batch continues to be processed.  
**INVALID\_ACCOUNT\_UPDATE\_HANDLING\_TYPE\_IGNORE\_INVALID\_UPDATES:**  
Invalid updates are ignored when processing the batch.  
  
**Default**  
**INVALID\_ACCOUNT\_UPDATE\_HANDLING\_TYPE\_FAIL\_BATCH**

## [](#accounts_version_2 "Copy link to heading")Accounts version 2

A Customer Account in Vault is an instance of a financial Product, whereas an Internal Account is used to allocate and track funds owned by the financial institution.

Introduced in Vault Core 5, the v2 Accounts endpoints enable higher throughput and simpler lifecycle management than the legacy endpoints.

For more information, see [Accounts version 2](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2).

info

When using [JSON Web Tokens (JWTs)](/vault-core/5-8/EN/vault_core_overview/vault_security#json_web_tokens) with pre-defined [static policies](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/policies/opa-policies#static_policies), the Accounts version 2 API enforces pre-Vault 5.0 permission structure as defined by default static policies.

This means that for clients using JWTs with pre-define static policies, the following permission scopes are required:

-   `core.accounts` for Customer Account access
    
-   `core.internal-accounts` for Internal Account access
    

This is to avoid potential privilege escalation. For example, clients with a single permission scope `core.accounts` cannot operate on internal accounts.

### [](#account_2 "Copy link to heading")Account

#### [](#available_methods_10 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v2_accounts_ListAccountsResponse_ListAccounts) Pages through an ordered list of Accounts based on filtering criteria.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_CreateAccount) Creates an Internal or Customer Account.
    
-   [Update](#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount) Updates an existing Internal or Customer Account.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v2_accounts_BatchGetAccountsResponse_BatchGetAccounts) Retrieves a set of Customer and/or Internal Accounts by their IDs.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v2_accounts_ListAccountsResponse_ListAccounts "Copy link to heading")List

Pages through an ordered list of Accounts based on filtering criteria. Every request must be filtered on either Customer or Internal Accounts.

info

When using [JSON Web Tokens (JWTs)](/vault-core/5-8/EN/vault_core_overview/vault_security#json_web_tokens) with pre-defined [static policies](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/policies/opa-policies#static_policies), the following permission scopes are required: \* `ACCOUNT_TYPE_CUSTOMER`: either `core:read` or `core.accounts:read` is required \* `ACCOUNT_TYPE_INTERNAL`: either `core:read` or `core.internal_accounts:read`.

info

When using this endpoint, there will be a short interval between a mutation being made to a given Account, and that mutation being reflected in the list response. This is to allow insertion of the record into [warm storage](/vault-core/5-8/EN/environment_and_installation/infrastructure_docs/vault_cloud_infrastructure/using_a_relational_database).

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.accounts:read, core.internal\_accounts:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /v2/accounts

##### [](#request_25 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be listed. Required; must have an integer value in the range 1-100.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Token of the page to retrieve. If empty, returns the first page of results. Optional.

 |
| 

**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of Account to filter on. Required.  
  
Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired type. An Account will never have this type.  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_CUSTOMER:**  
An Account for a Customer of the bank. Customer Accounts are backed by Smart Contracts.  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_INTERNAL:**  
An Account where the bank is the (implicit) stakeholder. Internal Accounts are not backed by Smart Contracts.  
  
**Default**  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

**stakeholder\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the stakeholder whose Accounts are to be listed. Optional.

 |
| 

**statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

List of inclusive OR Account status filters. Must be URL encoded. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired status. An Account will never have this status.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
An Account that has not been activated. If this status was requested, the PENDING response means that no hook has yet been run, no schedules will exist, and Postings will be rejected. If the OPEN status was requested, a PENDING response means that manual remediation is required. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPENING:**  
An Account in the process of being activated. Its activation hook has been successfully executed but the directives it produced may not have been committed yet. This status is intended to be short-lived; if it persists for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to OPEN status asynchronously. Postings will be rejected unless they come from the activation hook. Any such Postings may have been committed. Schedules may have been created. Notifications may have been sent.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN:**  
An Account has been activated. Postings are accepted based on the presence of any Restrictions, and the Smart Contract behaviour. Schedules have been created and commenced as of the activation time. In the event that Postings and/or notifications failed during the activation process, an error will be returned. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSING:**  
An Account is in the process of being closed. Its deactivation hook has been successfully executed but the resulting postings may not have been committed and schedules may not have been deactivated yet. This status is intended to be short-lived; if it persists for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to CLOSED status asynchronously. Postings are accepted based on the presence of any Restrictions, and the Smart Contract behaviour. Schedules may continue to execute if not yet deactivated.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
The Account has been closed. Its balances are zero and new postings will be rejected. All schedules have been deactivated, although latent events may still occur (which cannot affect balances). This is a terminal status. Some notifications may not have been successful in the deactivation process if an error was returned. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
The Account is cancelled. No hooks are allowed. No postings are allowed. No schedules exist. This status can only be moved to from PENDING.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_OPENING:**  
The Account is in pending open status.  
Postings will be rejected unless they come from the activation hook. Any such Postings may have been committed. Schedules may have been created. Notifications may have been sent. Once in this status an Account can only move to OPEN.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The Account is represented as OPEN on v1 endpoints. In v2, the Account may or may not be activated. Activation Account Updates are created which will activate the Account and update it to OPEN once complete.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
The Account is in pending closure status.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The closure Account update is created. The closure hook is run. The Account remains in this state until manually updated to closed. Balances are checked when transitioning to CLOSED.

The ID of the Smart Contract Version the Account is converting to. A non-empty value indicates that the conversion hook has been successfully executed and that directives are being committed. Vault will continually attempt to move to this Smart Contract Version asynchronously. Until the Account is successfully moved to this Smart Contract Version, hooks from its current Smart Contract Version will be executed. Immediately following moving to this Smart Contract Version, there may be delay in propagating changes; in some cases the hooks on the previous Smart Contract Version are executed for postings, scheduled events and parameter changes.

#### [](#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_CreateAccount "Copy link to heading")Create

Creates an Internal or Customer Account. Customer Accounts can be created in PENDING or OPEN status.  
**NOTE: Any restriction\_type can be applied to Customer Accounts; however, [Restrictions](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#Restrictions) cannot be overridden in /v2/accounts.**

info

When using [JSON Web Tokens (JWTs)](/vault-core/5-8/EN/vault_core_overview/vault_security#json_web_tokens) with pre-defined [static policies](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/policies/opa-policies#static_policies), the following permission scopes are required: \* `ACCOUNT_TYPE_CUSTOMER`: either `core:read` or `core.accounts:read` is required \* `ACCOUNT_TYPE_INTERNAL`: either `core:read` or `core.internal_accounts:read`.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.accounts:write, core.internal\_accounts:write

**Endpoint:** POST /v2/accounts

##### [](#request_26 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**request\_id**

 | 

A unique ID for the request. Used for idempotence.

 |
|

The Account to create.

 |

account.  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Account. When creating a customer Account this field is optional and will default to a UUID if not provided. When creating an internal Account this field is required. Max length: 36 characters.

 |
| 

account.  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of the Account. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired type. An Account will never have this type.  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_CUSTOMER:**  
An Account for a Customer of the bank. Customer Accounts are backed by Smart Contracts.  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_INTERNAL:**  
An Account where the bank is the (implicit) stakeholder. Internal Accounts are not backed by Smart Contracts.  
  
**Default**  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

account.  
**smart\_contract\_version\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Smart Contract Version the Account is currently on.  
  
*For create requests*: This must be set for Customer Accounts, but must be empty for Internal Accounts.  
  
*For update requests*: This can be directly updated to request the converting of a Customer Account to a new Smart Contract version.  
  
Only the hooks on this Smart Contract Version will be executed (supervisors and propagation delays notwithstanding) with the exception of the conversion hook which would be run for the pending Smart Contract Version.

 |

account.

array \[string\]

 | 

The list of stakeholders on the Account. Empty for Internal Accounts.

 |
| 

account.  
**alias**  
  
string

 | 

A user-provided alias for the Account. Optional.

 |
| 

account.  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the Account. When creating an Internal Account this must be set to OPEN. When creating a Customer Account this must be set to either PENDING or OPEN. This can only be updated to OPEN, CLOSED or CANCELLED.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired status. An Account will never have this status.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
An Account that has not been activated. If this status was requested, the PENDING response means that no hook has yet been run, no schedules will exist, and Postings will be rejected. If the OPEN status was requested, a PENDING response means that manual remediation is required. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPENING:**  
An Account in the process of being activated. Its activation hook has been successfully executed but the directives it produced may not have been committed yet. This status is intended to be short-lived; if it persists for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to OPEN status asynchronously. Postings will be rejected unless they come from the activation hook. Any such Postings may have been committed. Schedules may have been created. Notifications may have been sent.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN:**  
An Account has been activated. Postings are accepted based on the presence of any Restrictions, and the Smart Contract behaviour. Schedules have been created and commenced as of the activation time. In the event that Postings and/or notifications failed during the activation process, an error will be returned. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSING:**  
An Account is in the process of being closed. Its deactivation hook has been successfully executed but the resulting postings may not have been committed and schedules may not have been deactivated yet. This status is intended to be short-lived; if it persists for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to CLOSED status asynchronously. Postings are accepted based on the presence of any Restrictions, and the Smart Contract behaviour. Schedules may continue to execute if not yet deactivated.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
The Account has been closed. Its balances are zero and new postings will be rejected. All schedules have been deactivated, although latent events may still occur (which cannot affect balances). This is a terminal status. Some notifications may not have been successful in the deactivation process if an error was returned. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
The Account is cancelled. No hooks are allowed. No postings are allowed. No schedules exist. This status can only be moved to from PENDING.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_OPENING:**  
The Account is in pending open status.  
Postings will be rejected unless they come from the activation hook. Any such Postings may have been committed. Schedules may have been created. Notifications may have been sent. Once in this status an Account can only move to OPEN.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The Account is represented as OPEN on v1 endpoints. In v2, the Account may or may not be activated. Activation Account Updates are created which will activate the Account and update it to OPEN once complete.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
The Account is in pending closure status.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The closure Account update is created. The closure hook is run. The Account remains in this state until manually updated to closed. Balances are checked when transitioning to CLOSED.  
  
**Default**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

**pending\_smart\_contract\_version\_id**

The ID of the Smart Contract Version the Account is converting to. A non-empty value indicates that the conversion hook has been successfully executed and that directives are being committed. Vault sets this field automatically while converting the Account to a new Smart Contract Version; if it remains populated for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to this Smart Contract Version asynchronously. Until the Account is successfully moved to this Smart Contract Version, hooks from its current Smart Contract Version will be executed. Immediately following moving to this Smart Contract Version, there may be delay in propagating changes; in some cases the hooks on the previous Smart Contract Version are executed for postings, scheduled events and parameter changes.

An Account is in the process of being closed. Its deactivation hook has been successfully executed but the resulting postings may not have been committed and schedules may not have been deactivated yet. This status is intended to be short-lived; if it persists for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to CLOSED status asynchronously. Postings are accepted based on the presence of any Restrictions, and the Smart Contract behaviour. Schedules may continue to execute if not yet deactivated.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
The Account has been closed. Its balances are zero and new postings will be rejected. All schedules have been deactivated, although latent events may still occur (which cannot affect balances). This is a terminal status. Some notifications may not have been successful in the deactivation process if an error was returned. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
The Account is cancelled. No hooks are allowed. No postings are allowed. No schedules exist. This status can only be moved to from PENDING.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_OPENING:**  
The Account is in pending open status.  
Postings will be rejected unless they come from the activation hook. Any such Postings may have been committed. Schedules may have been created. Notifications may have been sent. Once in this status an Account can only move to OPEN.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The Account is represented as OPEN on v1 endpoints. In v2, the Account may or may not be activated. Activation Account Updates are created which will activate the Account and update it to OPEN once complete.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
The Account is in pending closure status.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The closure Account update is created. The closure hook is run. The Account remains in this state until manually updated to closed. Balances are checked when transitioning to CLOSED.

| 

**vault\_create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

When the Account was created in Vault, in UTC. Output only. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**source\_create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

When the Account was created, in UTC. Output only. This value may be backdated for Accounts migrated to Vault via the Data Loader API. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**source\_open\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

When the Account finished moving to status OPEN, in UTC. Output only. This value may be earlier than the `vault_create_timestamp` for Accounts migrated to Vault via the Data Loader API. This value is always greater than or equal to `source_create_timestamp`. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**source\_close\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

When the Account finished moving to status CLOSED, in UTC. Output only. This value may be earlier than the `vault_create_timestamp` for Accounts migrated to Vault via the Data Loader API. This value is always greater than or equal to `source_open_timestamp`. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**update\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

When the Account was last updated, in UTC. This field will have the same value as `vault_create_timestamp` for Accounts that have never been updated. Output only. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**activation\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The effective time that the Account’s activation hook was run, in UTC. This field can optionally be set to a backdated value when creating an open customer Account. If not provided, it will default to the time of the request. This value will be earlier than the `vault_create_timestamp` for Accounts created in OPEN, because the activation hook is executed before creating the Account. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. The value corresponds to the value of the `effective_datetime` hook argument when the activation hook is run.

 |
| 

**permitted\_denominations\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

A set of denominations, which is accessible from within the Smart Contract:  
  
\- If the Smart Contract Version specifies supported denominations, then this set must be a subset of those (if none are specified here then the field will be set to the Smart Contract Version’s supported denominations).  
\- If the Smart Contract Version does not specify denominations, then at least one must be specified when creating the Account.  
  
Incoming Postings are not required to specify a denomination contained in this list; if this validation is required then it must be implemented in the Smart Contract. This field cannot be updated, and cannot be populated for Internal Accounts, unless created via the v1/internal-accounts endpoint (deprecated).

 |
| 

**details**  
  
map \[string: string\]

 | 

User-provided key/value Account details. Vault does not use data stored here, it is purely for use by downstream systems. Entries can be removed by specifying a key with an empty value. Keys with values will create new entries or replace existing ones. Any existing entries with keys not in the request will not be modified. Optional.

 |
| 

**t\_side**  
  
enum

 | 

The side of the balance sheet where the Account balance is counted. Can be optionally provided when creating Internal Accounts. If it is not provided, it will default to LIABILITY. For Customer Accounts, the t\_side is defined in the Smart Contract. It cannot be provided in this request.  
  
**Enum values**  
**T\_SIDE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default Value, invalid.  
**T\_SIDE\_ASSET:**  
Debit postings increase balances for asset Accounts.  
**T\_SIDE\_LIABILITY:**  
Credit postings increase balances for liability Accounts.

 |
| 

**contract\_update\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The most recent time at which the Smart Contract Version was updated on the Account, in UTC. Empty if it has never changed. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. The value corresponds to the `effective_datetime` hook argument when the conversion hook was last run.

 |
| 

**processing\_group\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Processing Group the Account is in. Can only be provided for create requests. If omitted, the Account will be assigned to the default Processing Group.  
  
**Multiple Processing Groups are only available as an Extension.**

 |
| 

**parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Parameter Value Hierarchy Node which the Account is associated with. Optional.

 |
| 

**processing\_label**  
  
string

 | 

The processing label, used in Posting Instructions to target a particular Internal Account for the Customer Account’s Processing Group. Only one Internal Account can be assigned a specific label for each Processing Group. Can only be applied to Internal Accounts. Optional.  
  
**Multiple Processing Groups are only available as an Extension.**

#### [](#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates an existing Internal or Customer Account. This can be used to move a Customer Account from PENDING to OPEN, or from OPEN to CLOSED. It can also be used to convert a Customer Account to a new Smart Contract Version. See the update\_mask field documentation for more details of what can be updated.  
  
**NOTES: - Any restriction\_type can be applied to Customer Accounts; however, [Restrictions](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#Restrictions) cannot be overridden in /v2/accounts.  
\- For legacy Instance Parameters, any `default_value` specified in the Smart Contract will not be used on Account conversions.**

info

When using [JSON Web Tokens (JWTs)](/vault-core/5-8/EN/vault_core_overview/vault_security#json_web_tokens) with pre-defined [static policies](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/policies/opa-policies#static_policies), the following permission scopes are required: \* `ACCOUNT_TYPE_CUSTOMER`: either `core:read` or `core.accounts:read` is required \* `ACCOUNT_TYPE_INTERNAL`: either `core:read` or `core.internal_accounts:read`.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.accounts:write, core.internal\_accounts:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /v2/accounts/{account.id}

 |

account.  
**smart\_contract\_version\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Smart Contract Version the Account is currently on.  
  
*For create requests*: This must be set for Customer Accounts, but must be empty for Internal Accounts.  
  
*For update requests*: This can be directly updated to request the converting of a Customer Account to a new Smart Contract version.  
  
Only the hooks on this Smart Contract Version will be executed (supervisors and propagation delays notwithstanding) with the exception of the conversion hook which would be run for the pending Smart Contract Version.

 |
| 

account.

array \[string\]

 | 

The list of stakeholders on the Account. Empty for Internal Accounts.

 |
| 

account.  
**alias**  
  
string

 | 

A user-provided alias for the Account. Optional.

 |
| 

account.  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the Account. When creating an Internal Account this must be set to OPEN. When creating a Customer Account this must be set to either PENDING or OPEN. This can only be updated to OPEN, CLOSED or CANCELLED.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired status. An Account will never have this status.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
An Account that has not been activated. If this status was requested, the PENDING response means that no hook has yet been run, no schedules will exist, and Postings will be rejected. If the OPEN status was requested, a PENDING response means that manual remediation is required. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPENING:**  
An Account in the process of being activated. Its activation hook has been successfully executed but the directives it produced may not have been committed yet. This status is intended to be short-lived; if it persists for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to OPEN status asynchronously. Postings will be rejected unless they come from the activation hook. Any such Postings may have been committed. Schedules may have been created. Notifications may have been sent.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN:**  
An Account has been activated. Postings are accepted based on the presence of any Restrictions, and the Smart Contract behaviour. Schedules have been created and commenced as of the activation time. In the event that Postings and/or notifications failed during the activation process, an error will be returned. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSING:**  
An Account is in the process of being closed. Its deactivation hook has been successfully executed but the resulting postings may not have been committed and schedules may not have been deactivated yet. This status is intended to be short-lived; if it persists for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to CLOSED status asynchronously. Postings are accepted based on the presence of any Restrictions, and the Smart Contract behaviour. Schedules may continue to execute if not yet deactivated.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
The Account has been closed. Its balances are zero and new postings will be rejected. All schedules have been deactivated, although latent events may still occur (which cannot affect balances). This is a terminal status. Some notifications may not have been successful in the deactivation process if an error was returned. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
The Account is cancelled. No hooks are allowed. No postings are allowed. No schedules exist. This status can only be moved to from PENDING.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_OPENING:**  
The Account is in pending open status.  
Postings will be rejected unless they come from the activation hook. Any such Postings may have been committed. Schedules may have been created. Notifications may have been sent. Once in this status an Account can only move to OPEN.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The Account is represented as OPEN on v1 endpoints. In v2, the Account may or may not be activated. Activation Account Updates are created which will activate the Account and update it to OPEN once complete.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
The Account is in pending closure status.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The closure Account update is created. The closure hook is run. The Account remains in this state until manually updated to closed. Balances are checked when transitioning to CLOSED.  
  
**Default**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

 |
|

Keys with values will create new entries or replace existing ones. Any existing entries with keys not in the request will not be modified. Optional.

**pending\_smart\_contract\_version\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Smart Contract Version the Account is converting to. A non-empty value indicates that the conversion hook has been successfully executed and that directives are being committed. Vault sets this field automatically while converting the Account to a new Smart Contract Version; if it remains populated for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to this Smart Contract Version asynchronously. Until the Account is successfully moved to this Smart Contract Version, hooks from its current Smart Contract Version will be executed. Immediately following moving to this Smart Contract Version, there may be delay in propagating changes; in some cases the hooks on the previous Smart Contract Version are executed for postings, scheduled events and parameter changes.

enum

 | 

The side of the balance sheet where the Account balance is counted. Can be optionally provided when creating Internal Accounts. If it is not provided, it will default to LIABILITY. For Customer Accounts, the t\_side is defined in the Smart Contract. It cannot be provided in this request.  
  
**Enum values**  
**T\_SIDE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default Value, invalid.  
**T\_SIDE\_ASSET:**  
Debit postings increase balances for asset Accounts.  
**T\_SIDE\_LIABILITY:**  
Credit postings increase balances for liability Accounts.

 |
| 

**contract\_update\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The most recent time at which the Smart Contract Version was updated on the Account, in UTC. Empty if it has never changed. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. The value corresponds to the `effective_datetime` hook argument when the conversion hook was last run.

 |
| 

**processing\_group\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Processing Group the Account is in. Can only be provided for create requests. If omitted, the Account will be assigned to the default Processing Group.  
  
**Multiple Processing Groups are only available as an Extension.**

 |
| 

**parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Parameter Value Hierarchy Node which the Account is associated with. Optional.

 |
| 

**processing\_label**  
  
string

 | 

The processing label, used in Posting Instructions to target a particular Internal Account for the Customer Account’s Processing Group. Only one Internal Account can be assigned a specific label for each Processing Group. Can only be applied to Internal Accounts. Optional.  
  
**Multiple Processing Groups are only available as an Extension.**

**Metadata values**  
**restriction\_set.ids:**  
A JSON-encoded array of IDs of the Restriction Sets that contain the Restrictions that prevented the operation.  
**customer.id:**  
The ID of the Customer with the Restriction.  
**posting\_instruction\_batch.id:**  
The ID of the Posting Instruction Batch that was rejected due to the Restriction.  
**posting\_instruction\_batch.client\_batch\_id:**  
The Client Batch ID of the Posting Instruction Batch that was rejected due to the Restriction.  
**posting\_instruction\_batch.posting\_instructions.id:**  
The ID of the Posting Instruction that was rejected due to the Restriction.  
**account.status:**  
The status the Account is currently in. Only present if stakeholders of a Customer Account that is the destination for a Posting Instruction have a Restriction set or if Restrictions changed during a retry.Only present if the request mutates the Account’s status.  
**smart\_contract\_version.id:**  
The Smart Contract Version the Account is currently associated with. Only present if the stakeholders of a Customer Account that is the destination for a Posting Instruction have a Restriction set or if Restrictions changed during a retry. Only present if the request mutates the Smart Contract Version.

 |

Returned when the operation is prevented by a Restriction on this Account, or when a Posting Instruction returned by a Smart Contract Hook is rejected because of a Restriction on the target Customer Account.

field\_violations\[\].  
**violation\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Type of violation.  
  
**Enum values**  
**UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**INVALID\_FORMAT:**  
Field is not a valid format e.g. email address, UUID, IP Address, URI etc.  
**INVALID\_VALUE:**  
Indicates that a provided field is not equal to one of the specified values.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

 |
|

string

 | 

A description of why the request field is invalid.

#### [](#_core_api_v2_accounts_BatchGetAccountsResponse_BatchGetAccounts "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves a set of Customer and/or Internal Accounts by their IDs.

info

When using [JSON Web Tokens (JWTs)](/vault-core/5-8/EN/vault_core_overview/vault_security#json_web_tokens) with pre-defined [static policies](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/policies/opa-policies#static_policies), the following permission scopes are required: \* `ACCOUNT_TYPE_CUSTOMER`: either `core:read` or `core.accounts:read` is required \* `ACCOUNT_TYPE_INTERNAL`: either `core:read` or `core.internal_accounts:read`.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.accounts:read, core.internal\_accounts:read

**Endpoint:** GET /v2/accounts:batchGet

##### [](#request_28 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

A list of Account IDs. The maximum number of IDs is 100.  
  
Required.  
Max count: 100.

 |

##### [](#responses_5 "Copy link to heading")Responses

Success Errors

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**accounts**  
  
map \[string: object\]

 | 

The retrieved Accounts. This is a map Accounts keyed on ID.

 |
| 

accounts\[KEY\].  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Account. When creating a customer Account this field is optional and will default to a UUID if not provided. When creating an internal Account this field is required. Max length: 36 characters.

 |
| 

accounts\[KEY\].  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of the Account. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired type. An Account will never have this type.  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_CUSTOMER:**  
An Account for a Customer of the bank. Customer Accounts are backed by Smart Contracts.  
**ACCOUNT\_TYPE\_INTERNAL:**  
An Account where the bank is the (implicit) stakeholder. Internal Accounts are not backed by Smart Contracts.

 |
| 

accounts\[KEY\].  
**smart\_contract\_version\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Smart Contract Version the Account is currently on.  
  
*For create requests*: This must be set for Customer Accounts, but must be empty for Internal Accounts.  
  
*For update requests*: This can be directly updated to request the converting of a Customer Account to a new Smart Contract version.  
  
Only the hooks on this Smart Contract Version will be executed (supervisors and propagation delays notwithstanding) with the exception of the conversion hook which would be run for the pending Smart Contract Version.

 |
| 

accounts\[KEY\].  
**pending\_smart\_contract\_version\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Smart Contract Version the Account is converting to. A non-empty value indicates that the conversion hook has been successfully executed and that directives are being committed. Vault sets this field automatically while converting the Account to a new Smart Contract Version; if it remains populated for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to this Smart Contract Version asynchronously. Until the Account is successfully moved to this Smart Contract Version, hooks from its current Smart Contract Version will be executed. Immediately following moving to this Smart Contract Version, there may be delay in propagating changes; in some cases the hooks on the previous Smart Contract Version are executed for postings, scheduled events and parameter changes.

 |
| 

accounts\[KEY\].  
**stakeholder\_ids\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The list of stakeholders on the Account. Empty for Internal Accounts.

 |
| 

accounts\[KEY\].  
**alias**  
  
string

 | 

A user-provided alias for the Account. Optional.

 |
| 

accounts\[KEY\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the Account. When creating an Internal Account this must be set to OPEN. When creating a Customer Account this must be set to either PENDING or OPEN. This can only be updated to OPEN, CLOSED or CANCELLED.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired status. An Account will never have this status.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
An Account that has not been activated. If this status was requested, the PENDING response means that no hook has yet been run, no schedules will exist, and Postings will be rejected. If the OPEN status was requested, a PENDING response means that manual remediation is required. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPENING:**  
An Account in the process of being activated. Its activation hook has been successfully executed but the directives it produced may not have been committed yet. This status is intended to be short-lived; if it persists for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to OPEN status asynchronously. Postings will be rejected unless they come from the activation hook. Any such Postings may have been committed. Schedules may have been created. Notifications may have been sent.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN:**  
An Account has been activated. Postings are accepted based on the presence of any Restrictions, and the Smart Contract behaviour. Schedules have been created and commenced as of the activation time. In the event that Postings and/or notifications failed during the activation process, an error will be returned. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSING:**  
An Account is in the process of being closed. Its deactivation hook has been successfully executed but the resulting postings may not have been committed and schedules may not have been deactivated yet. This status is intended to be short-lived; if it persists for any length of time it may indicate that user intervention is required. Vault will continually attempt to move to CLOSED status asynchronously. Postings are accepted based on the presence of any Restrictions, and the Smart Contract behaviour. Schedules may continue to execute if not yet deactivated.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
The Account has been closed. Its balances are zero and new postings will be rejected. All schedules have been deactivated, although latent events may still occur (which cannot affect balances). This is a terminal status. Some notifications may not have been successful in the deactivation process if an error was returned. For more information, see [Troubleshooting Customer Accounts](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#troubleshooting_customer_accounts).  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
The Account is cancelled. No hooks are allowed. No postings are allowed. No schedules exist. This status can only be moved to from PENDING.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_OPENING:**  
The Account is in pending open status.  
Postings will be rejected unless they come from the activation hook. Any such Postings may have been committed. Schedules may have been created. Notifications may have been sent. Once in this status an Account can only move to OPEN.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The Account is represented as OPEN on v1 endpoints. In v2, the Account may or may not be activated. Activation Account Updates are created which will activate the Account and update it to OPEN once complete.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
The Account is in pending closure status.  
DEPRECATED: This status exists to support v1 endpoints on v2 and will be removed no earlier than Vault Core 7.0. The closure Account update is created. The closure hook is run. The Account remains in this state until manually updated to closed. Balances are checked when transitioning to CLOSED.

When the Account finished moving to status OPEN, in UTC. Output only. This value may be earlier than the `vault_create_timestamp` for Accounts migrated to Vault via the Data Loader API. This value is always greater than or equal to `source_create_timestamp`. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |

accounts\[KEY\].  
**source\_close\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

When the Account finished moving to status CLOSED, in UTC. Output only. This value may be earlier than the `vault_create_timestamp` for Accounts migrated to Vault via the Data Loader API. This value is always greater than or equal to `source_open_timestamp`. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |

accounts\[KEY\].  
**update\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

When the Account was last updated, in UTC. This field will have the same value as `vault_create_timestamp` for Accounts that have never been updated. Output only. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

accounts\[KEY\].  
**activation\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The effective time that the Account’s activation hook was run, in UTC. This field can optionally be set to a backdated value when creating an open customer Account. If not provided, it will default to the time of the request. This value will be earlier than the `vault_create_timestamp` for Accounts created in OPEN, because the activation hook is executed before creating the Account. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. The value corresponds to the value of the `effective_datetime` hook argument when the activation hook is run.

 |
| 

accounts\[KEY\].  
**permitted\_denominations\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

A set of denominations, which is accessible from within the Smart Contract:  
  
\- If the Smart Contract Version specifies supported denominations, then this set must be a subset of those (if none are specified here then the field will be set to the Smart Contract Version’s supported denominations).  
\- If the Smart Contract Version does not specify denominations, then at least one must be specified when creating the Account.  
  
Incoming Postings are not required to specify a denomination contained in this list; if this validation is required then it must be implemented in the Smart Contract. This field cannot be updated, and cannot be populated for Internal Accounts, unless created via the v1/internal-accounts endpoint (deprecated).

 |

accounts\[KEY\].  
**details**  
  
map \[string: string\]

 | 

User-provided key/value Account details. Vault does not use data stored here, it is purely for use by downstream systems. Entries can be removed by specifying a key with an empty value. Keys with values will create new entries or replace existing ones. Any existing entries with keys not in the request will not be modified. Optional.

 |
