posting\_instruction\_batch\_created\_events\[\].  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
authorisation\_adjustment.  
**amount**  
  
string

 | 

A delta amount. The sign of the delta can be given explicitly (`"+3.40"`, `"-20"`) or implicitly if it is positive (e.g "3.40" is the same as "+3.40").  
  
*The amount of the AuthorisationAdjustment, which can be specified as a delta (the difference between the previous amount and the new amount) or as a new total authorised amount. On a response, it is recommended to inspect the `delta_amount` and `authorised_amount` fields as they contain the same information but, unlike the `adjustment_amount.amount` or `adjustment_amount.replacement_amount` fields, they are guaranteed to be set on an accepted PostingInstructionBatch.  
  
authorisation\_adjustment can contain one of **amount** or replacement\_amount*

 |
| 

posting\_instruction\_batch\_created\_events\[\].  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
authorisation\_adjustment.  
**replacement\_amount**  
  
string

 | 

A new amount, to replace the existing authorised amount.  
  
*The amount of the AuthorisationAdjustment, which can be specified as a delta (the difference between the previous amount and the new amount) or as a new total authorised amount. On a response, it is recommended to inspect the `delta_amount` and `authorised_amount` fields as they contain the same information but, unlike the `adjustment_amount.amount` or `adjustment_amount.replacement_amount` fields, they are guaranteed to be set on an accepted PostingInstructionBatch.  
  
authorisation\_adjustment can contain one of amount or **replacement\_amount***

 |
|

posting\_instructions\[\].

object

*posting\_instructions\[\] items can contain one of outbound\_authorisation, inbound\_authorisation, authorisation\_adjustment, **settlement**, release, inbound\_hard\_settlement, outbound\_hard\_settlement, transfer or custom\_instruction*

 |
|

posting\_instructions\[\].  
settlement.

The amount to be cleared. Optional: if not supplied it will be calculated as amount = total amount authorised for this client transaction - total amount cleared.

**internal\_account\_processing\_label**  
  
string

 | 

You can use a processing label to specify an Internal Account as part of a Custom Instruction instead of directly referencing an account ID. If you use a processing label in a CustomInstruction, there must be at least one posting in the same instruction that does not use a label, using the account\_id instead. The internal account then resolves using the processing group of the account identified by this account\_id. If a posting of a CustomInstruction using a processing label does not contain an account\_id, this request will fail. You also cannot instruct a CustomInstruction in which labels are used in all its postings.  
  
**Multiple Processing Groups are only available as an Extension.**

posting\_instruction\_batch\_created\_events\[\].  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
**value\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Specifies the time at which all committed postings of this batch’s posting instructions will affect balances. For most cases, including real time payments or fund movements, this does not require setting and will default to the generated `insertion_timestamp`. Only backdating of posting instruction batches is supported; this means that you cannot set them to be in the future, as determined by the clock of the ledger service. The earliest allowed value is 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Optional; defaults to the insertion timestamp in UTC.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.5**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*This field is replaced by the value\_timestamp in the PostingInstruction. Deprecated only in the Postings API - not deprecated in the Postings Migration API.*

 |
| 

posting\_instruction\_batch\_created\_events\[\].  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
**booking\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Optional. Specifies the booking time of all committed postings of this batch’s Posting Instructions. Defaults to `value_timestamp` (which, in turn, defaults to `insertion_timestamp`). Can only be used for back-booked Posting Instruction Batches (PIBs), and can only be set if `value_timestamp` is also passed in the request; in which case `booking_timestamp` must be later than `value_timestamp`.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.5**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*This field is replaced by the booking\_timestamp in the PostingInstruction. Deprecated only in the Postings API - not deprecated in the Postings Migration API.*

## [](#customers "Copy link to heading")Customers

Used to create and update customers and customer details. At creation, a customer can be given a string-formatted numeric ID or have one automatically generated. The only requirement for a customer to act as a stakeholder on an account is that they need to have an ACTIVE status. Most of the APIs here describe how to map other optional information to a customer, including their:

-   Name
    
-   Address
    
-   Contact details
    
-   Preferred method of communication
    
-   Accessibility requirements
    

The customer status can also be set and may be used to:

-   Control whether accounts can be opened for that customer
    
-   Indicate if a customer is a prospect, has an active status or is deceased
    

error

Thought Machine strongly recommends that clients do not store any personal data or personally identifiable information (PII) in any instance of Vault. It is expected that clients will store such personal data/PII in their own long term data stores and/or System of Records. Note that clients are solely responsible for maintaining their own long term data stores and/or System of Records along with all customer data stored therein, including personal data/PII.

### [](#customer "Copy link to heading")Customer

#### [](#available_methods_31 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_customers_ListCustomersResponse_ListCustomers) Lists customers with pagination (deprecated). **(Deprecated)**
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_customers_Customer_CreateCustomer) Creates a new customer.
    
-   [Update](#_core_api_v1_customers_Customer_UpdateCustomer) Used to update a customer’s status and identifiers.
    
-   [Get](#_core_api_v1_customers_Customer_GetCustomer) Retrieves a customer.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_customers_BatchGetCustomersResponse_BatchGetCustomers) Retrieves customers for the customer IDs provided.
    
-   [Search](#_core_api_v1_customers_ListCustomersResponse_SearchCustomers) Lists customers with pagination.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_customers_ListCustomersResponse_ListCustomers "Copy link to heading")List

**Deprecated** as of release **4.7**, and will be removed no earlier than release **6.0** *This method is deprecated in favour of /v1/customers:search*

Lists customers with pagination (deprecated).

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.customers:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/customers

##### [](#request_69 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

List of inclusive OR customer status filters. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The customer status is unknown.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The customer status is active. To open an account, the customer status must be active; accounts cannot be opened for a customer with any other customer status. The status of an active customer could change to either frozen or deceased but cannot change to prospect.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_FROZEN:**  
The customer status is frozen. Accounts cannot be opened for the customer. The status of a frozen customer could change to either active or deceased but cannot change to prospect.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_DECEASED:**  
The customer status is deceased. Accounts cannot be opened for the customer but may still be active. The status of a deceased customer could change to either active or frozen but cannot change to prospect.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_PROSPECT:**  
The customer status is not yet active. Accounts cannot be opened. The status of a prospect customer can only change to active. Once the status has changed from prospect, it cannot be changed back to prospect.

The customer status is unknown.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The customer status is active. To open an account, the customer status must be active; accounts cannot be opened for a customer with any other customer status. The status of an active customer could change to either frozen or deceased but cannot change to prospect.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_FROZEN:**  
The customer status is frozen. Accounts cannot be opened for the customer. The status of a frozen customer could change to either active or deceased but cannot change to prospect.

**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_PROSPECT:**  
The customer status is not yet active. Accounts cannot be opened. The status of a prospect customer can only change to active. Once the status has changed from prospect, it cannot be changed back to prospect.

**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The customer status is active. To open an account, the customer status must be active; accounts cannot be opened for a customer with any other customer status. The status of an active customer could change to either frozen or deceased but cannot change to prospect.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_FROZEN:**

**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_PROSPECT:**  
The customer status is not yet active. Accounts cannot be opened. The status of a prospect customer can only change to active. Once the status has changed from prospect, it cannot be changed back to prospect.

**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The customer status is active. To open an account, the customer status must be active; accounts cannot be opened for a customer with any other customer status. The status of an active customer could change to either frozen or deceased but cannot change to prospect.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_FROZEN:**  
The customer status is frozen. Accounts cannot be opened for the customer. The status of a frozen customer could change to either active or deceased but cannot change to prospect.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_DECEASED:**  
The customer status is deceased. Accounts cannot be opened for the customer but may still be active. The status of a deceased customer could change to either active or frozen but cannot change to prospect.  
**CUSTOMER\_STATUS\_PROSPECT:**  
The customer status is not yet active. Accounts cannot be opened. The status of a prospect customer can only change to active. Once the status has changed from prospect, it cannot be changed back to prospect.

## [](#flags "Copy link to heading")Flags

Flags are binary markers that can be used to store information about an account or a customer. Flags can be [accessed](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/vault#get_flags_timeseries) from Smart Contracts, where they can be used to modify product behaviour.

For more information, see the [Flags](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/flags/) documentation.

### [](#flag "Copy link to heading")Flag

#### [](#available_methods_35 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_flags_ListFlagsResponse_ListFlags) Retrieves Flags that correspond to the parameters supplied.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_flags_Flag_CreateFlag) Creates a Flag.
    
-   [Update](#_core_api_v1_flags_Flag_UpdateFlag) Updates a Flag.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_flags_BatchGetFlagsResponse_BatchGetFlags) Retrieves Flags that correspond to the requested Flag IDs.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_flags_ListFlagsResponse_ListFlags "Copy link to heading")List

Retrieves Flags that correspond to the parameters supplied.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.flags:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/flags

##### [](#request_80 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**flag\_definition\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The Flag Definition ID that returned Flags should correspond to. Optional.

 |
| 

**customer\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of customers the applied Flags should be included for. Optional. If used in conjunction with account\_ids or payment\_device\_ids (deprecated), each Flag returned will match one of the provided filters.

 |
| 

**account\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of accounts the applied Flags should be included for. Optional. If used in conjunction with customer\_ids or payment\_device\_ids (deprecated), each Flag returned will match one of the provided filters.

 |
| 

**payment\_device\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of payment devices the applied Flags should be included for. Optional. If used in conjunction with account\_ids or customer\_ids, each Flag returned will match one of the provided filters.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.2**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Deprecated due to lack of use.*

 |
| 

**flag\_visibility\_level**  
  
enum

 | 

The Flag visibility level that Flags are to be returned for. Set this to FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_OPERATOR to return only Flags belonging to a Flag Definition with a flag\_visibility=FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_OPERATOR. Set this to FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_CONTRACT to return all Flags. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired status. A Flag will never have this status.  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_CONTRACT:**  
The Flag is visible only to Smart Contracts.  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_OPERATOR:**  
The Flag is visible to UI operators and Smart Contracts.  
  
**Default**  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

**effective\_timestamp**  
  
string

 | 

Timestamp after which the Flag will be effective, in UTC. Cannot be used in conjunction with effective\_timestamp\_range. Optional. Must be formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.2**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Use effective\_timestamp\_range instead.*

 |
| 

**effective\_timestamp\_range**  
  
object

 | 

The timestamp range that must overlap with the period of time when a Flag becomes effective and expires if the Flag is to be included; if the range and period of time do not overlap, the Flag will not be included. This range is from effective\_timestamp\_range.from up to and not including effective\_timestamp\_range.to. Optional.

 |
| 

effective\_timestamp\_range.  
**from**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Lower end of the range. The range is inclusive of its lower end.

 |
| 

effective\_timestamp\_range.  
**to**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Upper end of the range. The range is exclusive of its upper end.

 |
| 

**include\_inactive**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether inactive Flags are included. Optional.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.2**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Deprecated due to the deprecation of is\_active. Use effective\_timestamp\_range instead. The Flag would be considered active if the current timestamp was between its effective and expiry timestamps.*

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be retrieved. Required; must be non-zero and less than 3000. The 6.0 release will reduce the maximum page size to 100.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 3000.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, returns the first page of results. Optional.

 |

Success Errors

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**flags\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

A list of matching Flags, sorted by descending creation time.

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Flag. Output only. From Vault version 5.2 onwards, this defaults to a UUID.

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**description**  
  
string

 | 

The description of the Flag. Optional for create requests.

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**flag\_definition\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Flag Definition. Required for create requests.

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**value**  
  
enum

 | 

Determines how the Flag will behave when resolving the timeseries. Flags with a Value of `FLAG_VALUE_ON` will be resolved as `True`, and a Value of `FLAG_VALUE_OFF` will be resolved as `False`. Defaults to `FLAG_VALUE_ON`. If there are multiple overlapping Flags, the most recently created one will take precendence. If an Account has multiple Stakeholders with conflicting Flags for the same Flag Definition ID, the `FLAG_VALUE_ON` Flag will take precendence.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FLAG\_VALUE\_ON:**  
A Flag with Value `FLAG_VALUE_ON` will be treated as `True` for its effective range when resolving the Flag timeseries.  
**FLAG\_VALUE\_OFF:**  
A Flag with Value `FLAG_VALUE_OFF` will be treated as `False` for its effective range when resolving the Flag timeseries.

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**effective\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp at which the Flag becomes effective, in UTC. For create requests, can be either:  
\- left empty (for a flag effective immediately);  
\- set to a time in the future (to schedule a flag taking effect); or  
\- set to a time in the past (if the `is_backdated` field is set to true).  
Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**expiry\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp at which the Flag stops being effective, in UTC. The Flag is considered effective between `effective_timestamp` and `expiry_timestamp`.  
\- If `expiry_timestamp` is specified, it must be after the `effective_timestamp` time.  
\- If `expiry_timestamp` is not specified, the Flag is considered effective from its `effective_timestamp` onwards.  
Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**is\_active**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates if the Flag is active. Update only.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.2**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Use Flags with FLAG\_VALUE\_OFF to control Flag activity instead. Flags are considered active between their effective and expiry timestamps.*

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**is\_backdated**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Flag was a backdated change, meaning its `effective_timestamp` was set to a time earlier than when it was created. To allow the `effective_timestamp` to be in the past, this must be set to true when creating a Flag. Optional.

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**creation\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

The timestamp indicating when the Flag was created, in UTC. Output only. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.2**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Use the create\_timestamp field instead.*

 |
| 

flags\[\].  
**create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

The timestamp indicating when the flag was created, in UTC. Output only. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

flags\[\].

string

*The entity the Flag applies to. Required for create requests.

#### [](#_core_api_v1_flags_Flag_CreateFlag "Copy link to heading")Create

Creates a Flag.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.flags:write

**Endpoint:** POST /v1/flags

##### [](#request_81 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**flag**  
  
object

 | 

The Flag that is to be created. Required.

 |
| 

flag.  
**description**  
  
string

 | 

The description of the Flag. Optional for create requests.

 |
| 

flag.  
**flag\_definition\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Flag Definition. Required for create requests.

 |
| 

flag.  
**value**  
  
enum

 | 

Determines how the Flag will behave when resolving the timeseries. Flags with a Value of `FLAG_VALUE_ON` will be resolved as `True`, and a Value of `FLAG_VALUE_OFF` will be resolved as `False`. Defaults to `FLAG_VALUE_ON`. If there are multiple overlapping Flags, the most recently created one will take precendence. If an Account has multiple Stakeholders with conflicting Flags for the same Flag Definition ID, the `FLAG_VALUE_ON` Flag will take precendence.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FLAG\_VALUE\_ON:**  
A Flag with Value `FLAG_VALUE_ON` will be treated as `True` for its effective range when resolving the Flag timeseries.  
**FLAG\_VALUE\_OFF:**  
A Flag with Value `FLAG_VALUE_OFF` will be treated as `False` for its effective range when resolving the Flag timeseries.  
  
**Default**  
**FLAG\_VALUE\_ON**

 |
| 

flag.  
**effective\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp at which the Flag becomes effective, in UTC. For create requests, can be either:  
\- left empty (for a flag effective immediately);  
\- set to a time in the future (to schedule a flag taking effect); or  
\- set to a time in the past (if the `is_backdated` field is set to true).  
Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

flag.  
**expiry\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp at which the Flag stops being effective, in UTC. The Flag is considered effective between `effective_timestamp` and `expiry_timestamp`.  
\- If `expiry_timestamp` is specified, it must be after the `effective_timestamp` time.  
\- If `expiry_timestamp` is not specified, the Flag is considered effective from its `effective_timestamp` onwards.  
Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

flag.  
**is\_backdated**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Flag was a backdated change, meaning its `effective_timestamp` was set to a time earlier than when it was created. To allow the `effective_timestamp` to be in the past, this must be set to true when creating a Flag. Optional.

 |
| 

flag.  
**customer\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The customer ID the Flag applies to.  
  
*The entity the Flag applies to. Required for create requests.  
  
flag can contain one of **customer\_id**, account\_id or payment\_device\_id*

 |
| 

flag.  
**account\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The account ID the Flag applies to.  
  
*The entity the Flag applies to. Required for create requests.  
  
flag can contain one of customer\_id, **account\_id** or payment\_device\_id*

 |
| 

flag.  
**payment\_device\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The payment device ID the Flag applies to.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.1**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Deprecated due to lack of use.*  
  
*The entity the Flag applies to. Required for create requests.  
  
flag can contain one of customer\_id, account\_id or **payment\_device\_id***

 |
| 

**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

A unique string ID used to ensure the request is idempotent.  
  
Required.  
Max length: 256 characters.

 |

#### [](#_core_api_v1_flags_Flag_UpdateFlag "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates a Flag.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.flags:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /v1/flags/{flag.id}

##### [](#request_82 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
flag.  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Flag. Output only. From Vault version 5.2 onwards, this defaults to a UUID.

 |

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**flag**  
  
object

 | 

The Flag that is to be updated. Required.

 |
| 

flag.  
**description**  
  
string

 | 

The description of the Flag. Optional for create requests.

 |
| 

flag.  
**is\_active**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates if the Flag is active. Update only.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.2**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Use Flags with FLAG\_VALUE\_OFF to control Flag activity instead. Flags are considered active between their effective and expiry timestamps.*

 |
| 

**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

A unique string ID used to ensure the request is idempotent.  
  
Required.  
Max length: 256 characters.

 |
| 

**update\_mask**  
  
object

 | 

Field mask used to indicate which fields in the Flag are to be updated. Valid paths in the update mask are 'description' and 'is\_active'. Required.  
From Vault version 5.2, using 'is\_active' in the update path is deprecated in favour of creating Flags with Value `FLAG_VALUE_OFF`.

 |
| 

update\_mask.  
**paths\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The set of field mask paths.

 |

##### [](#responses_28 "Copy link to heading")Responses

Success Errors

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Flag. Output only. From Vault version 5.2 onwards, this defaults to a UUID.

 |
| 

**description**  
  
string

 | 

The description of the Flag. Optional for create requests.

 |
| 

**flag\_definition\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Flag Definition. Required for create requests.

 |
| 

**value**  
  
enum

 | 

Determines how the Flag will behave when resolving the timeseries. Flags with a Value of `FLAG_VALUE_ON` will be resolved as `True`, and a Value of `FLAG_VALUE_OFF` will be resolved as `False`. Defaults to `FLAG_VALUE_ON`. If there are multiple overlapping Flags, the most recently created one will take precendence. If an Account has multiple Stakeholders with conflicting Flags for the same Flag Definition ID, the `FLAG_VALUE_ON` Flag will take precendence.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FLAG\_VALUE\_ON:**  
A Flag with Value `FLAG_VALUE_ON` will be treated as `True` for its effective range when resolving the Flag timeseries.  
**FLAG\_VALUE\_OFF:**  
A Flag with Value `FLAG_VALUE_OFF` will be treated as `False` for its effective range when resolving the Flag timeseries.

 |
| 

**effective\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp at which the Flag becomes effective, in UTC. For create requests, can be either:  
\- left empty (for a flag effective immediately);  
\- set to a time in the future (to schedule a flag taking effect); or  
\- set to a time in the past (if the `is_backdated` field is set to true).  
Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

**expiry\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp at which the Flag stops being effective, in UTC. The Flag is considered effective between `effective_timestamp` and `expiry_timestamp`.  
\- If `expiry_timestamp` is specified, it must be after the `effective_timestamp` time.  
\- If `expiry_timestamp` is not specified, the Flag is considered effective from its `effective_timestamp` onwards.  
Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

**is\_active**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates if the Flag is active. Update only.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.2**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Use Flags with FLAG\_VALUE\_OFF to control Flag activity instead. Flags are considered active between their effective and expiry timestamps.*

 |
| 

**is\_backdated**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Flag was a backdated change, meaning its `effective_timestamp` was set to a time earlier than when it was created. To allow the `effective_timestamp` to be in the past, this must be set to true when creating a Flag. Optional.

 |
| 

**creation\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp indicating when the Flag was created, in UTC. Output only. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.2**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Use the create\_timestamp field instead.*

 |
| 

**create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp indicating when the flag was created, in UTC. Output only. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

**customer\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The customer ID the Flag applies to.  
  
*The entity the Flag applies to. Required for create requests.  
  
This can contain one of **customer\_id**, account\_id or payment\_device\_id*

 |
| 

**account\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The account ID the Flag applies to.  
  
*The entity the Flag applies to. Required for create requests.  
  
This can contain one of customer\_id, **account\_id** or payment\_device\_id*

 |
| 

**payment\_device\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The payment device ID the Flag applies to.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.1**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Deprecated due to lack of use.*  
  
*The entity the Flag applies to. Required for create requests.  
  
This can contain one of customer\_id, account\_id or **payment\_device\_id***

#### [](#available_methods_36 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_flags_ListFlagDefinitionsResponse_ListFlagDefinitions) Retrieves Flag Definitions that correspond to the parameters supplied.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_flags_FlagDefinition_CreateFlagDefinition) Creates a Flag Definition.
    
-   [Update](#_core_api_v1_flags_FlagDefinition_UpdateFlagDefinition) Updates a Flag Definition.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_flags_BatchGetFlagDefinitionsResponse_BatchGetFlagDefinitions) Retrieves Flag Definitions that correspond to the requested Flag Definition IDs.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_flags_ListFlagDefinitionsResponse_ListFlagDefinitions "Copy link to heading")List

Retrieves Flag Definitions that correspond to the parameters supplied.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.flag\_definitions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/flag-definitions

##### [](#request_84 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**flag\_visibility\_level**  
  
enum

 | 

The Flag visibility level that Flag Definitions are to be returned for. Set this to FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_OPERATOR to return Flag Definitions with Flag visibility=FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_OPERATOR. Set this to FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_CONTRACT to return all Flag Definitions. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired status. A Flag will never have this status.  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_CONTRACT:**  
The Flag is visible only to Smart Contracts.  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_OPERATOR:**  
The Flag is visible to UI operators and Smart Contracts.  
  
**Default**  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

**flag\_levels**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The Flag levels in the Flag Definition. If unspecified, this is equivalent to all Flag levels. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FLAG\_LEVEL\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired status. A Flag will never have this status.  
**FLAG\_LEVEL\_CUSTOMER:**  
Makes a Flag apply to the customer ID.  
**FLAG\_LEVEL\_ACCOUNT:**  
Makes a Flag apply to the account ID.  
**FLAG\_LEVEL\_PAYMENT\_DEVICE:**  
Makes a Flag apply to the payment device ID.  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.1**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Deprecated due to lack of use.*

 |
| 

**include\_inactive**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether inactive Flag Definitions are included. Optional.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

Number of results to be retrieved. Required; must be non-zero. The Vault Core 6.0 release will reduce the maximum page size to 100.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 500.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, returns the first page of results. Optional.

 |

#### [](#_core_api_v1_flags_FlagDefinition_UpdateFlagDefinition "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates a Flag Definition.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.flag\_definitions:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /v1/flag-definitions/{flag\_definition.id}

##### [](#request_86 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
flag\_definition.  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Flag Definition. Matches the name field. One of ID or name must be provided for create requests. If both are provided, ID will be used.

 |

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**flag\_definition**  
  
object

 | 

The Flag Definition that is to be updated. Required.

 |
| 

flag\_definition.  
**is\_active**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates if the Flag Definition is active. Update only.  
  
Note: Once a Flag Definition is set to inactive, it cannot be activated again.

 |
| 

**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

A unique string ID used to ensure the request is idempotent.  
  
Required.  
Max length: 256 characters.

 |
| 

**update\_mask**  
  
object

 | 

Field mask used to indicate which fields in the Flag Definition are to be updated. The only valid path in the update\_mask is 'is\_active'. Required.

 |
| 

update\_mask.  
**paths\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The set of field mask paths.

 |

##### [](#responses_32 "Copy link to heading")Responses

Success Errors

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Flag Definition. Matches the name field. One of ID or name must be provided for create requests. If both are provided, ID will be used.

 |
| 

**name**  
  
string

 | 

The name of the Flag Definition. Matches the ID field. One of ID or name must be provided for create requests. If both are provided, ID will be used.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.2**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Use the id field instead.*

 |
| 

**description**  
  
string

 | 

The description of the Flag Definition. Optional for create requests.

 |
| 

**is\_active**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates if the Flag Definition is active. Update only.  
  
Note: Once a Flag Definition is set to inactive, it cannot be activated again.

 |
| 

**required\_flag\_level**  
  
enum

 | 

The level required to create this Flag. Required for create requests.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FLAG\_LEVEL\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired status. A Flag will never have this status.  
**FLAG\_LEVEL\_CUSTOMER:**  
Makes a Flag apply to the customer ID.  
**FLAG\_LEVEL\_ACCOUNT:**  
Makes a Flag apply to the account ID.  
**FLAG\_LEVEL\_PAYMENT\_DEVICE:**  
Makes a Flag apply to the payment device ID.  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.1**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*Deprecated due to lack of use.*

 |
| 

**flag\_visibility**  
  
enum

 | 

The Flag visibility. Used to hide Flags from users where these are not relevant to them. Used when listing Flags. Required for create requests.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_UNKNOWN:**  
This status exists to avoid an empty request unintentionally setting an undesired status. A Flag will never have this status.  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_CONTRACT:**  
The Flag is visible only to Smart Contracts.  
**FLAG\_VISIBILITY\_OPERATOR:**  
The Flag is visible to UI operators and Smart Contracts.

 |
| 

**create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time the Flag Definition was created, in UTC. Output only. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

## [](#global_parameters "Copy link to heading")Global parameters

Global parameters let you define parameters and their values, and they can be accessed through the Core API. These can be used by Vault services such as Smart Contracts to perform financial decisioning.

Global parameters are composed of two different resources:

-   `GlobalParameter` defines the metadata and the shape of the parameter
    
-   `GlobalParameterValue` contains the actual value for a parameter at a point in time
    

This means that a global parameter can have multiple values which are effective at different points in time.

A bank’s interest rate would be a typical use of this. It will change throughout the years but will be the same parameter for all products within a bank.

A `GlobalParameter` has an `id` (unique name of the parameter) which is set at creation time, and is the identifier a Smart Contract uses to retrieve its value. See [Contract parameters](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/concepts#contract_parameters) for more information.

### [](#globalparameter "Copy link to heading")GlobalParameter

#### [](#available_methods_37 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_global_parameters_ListGlobalParametersResponse_ListGlobalParameters) Lists `GlobalParameters` with pagination.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_global_parameters_GlobalParameter_CreateGlobalParameter) Creates a new `GlobalParameter`.
    
-   [Get](#_core_api_v1_global_parameters_GlobalParameter_GetGlobalParameter) Retrieves a `GlobalParameter`.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_global_parameters_BatchGetGlobalParametersResponse_BatchGetGlobalParameters) Retrieves `GlobalParameter`s for the provided IDs.

### [](#globalparametervalue "Copy link to heading")GlobalParameterValue

#### [](#available_methods_38 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_global_parameters_ListGlobalParameterValuesResponse_ListGlobalParameterValues) Lists `GlobalParameterValue`s for a given `GlobalParameter` ID and an optional time range with pagination.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_global_parameters_GlobalParameterValue_CreateGlobalParameterValue) Creates a new `GlobalParameterValue`.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_global_parameters_ListGlobalParameterValuesResponse_ListGlobalParameterValues "Copy link to heading")List

Lists `GlobalParameterValue`s for a given `GlobalParameter` ID and an optional time range with pagination.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.global\_parameter\_values:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/global-parameter-values

##### [](#request_92 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**global\_parameter\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The `GlobalParameter` ID to retrieve values for.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

**effective\_timestamp\_range**  
  
object

 | 

Optional time range. If provided, only `GlobalParameterValue`s that have the appropriate `effective_timestamp` will be retrieved. If the `effective_timestamp_range.from` attribute is not provided, it defaults to the minimum timestamp. If `effective_timestamp_range.to` is not provided, it defaults to the maximum timestamp.

 |
| 

effective\_timestamp\_range.  
**from**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Lower end of the range. The range is inclusive of its lower end.

 |
| 

effective\_timestamp\_range.  
**to**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Upper end of the range. The range is exclusive of its upper end.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of `GlobalParametersValues` to be retrieved.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, this returns the first page of results.

 |

##### [](#responses_38 "Copy link to heading")Responses

Success Errors

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**global\_parameter\_values\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

A list of `GlobalParameterValue`s, ordered by ascending effective time.

 |
| 

global\_parameter\_values\[\].  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The `GlobalParameterValue` ID.

 |
| 

global\_parameter\_values\[\].  
**global\_parameter\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The `GlobalParameter` ID this value belongs to.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

global\_parameter\_values\[\].  
**value**  
  
string

 | 

The actual value. This is stored as a string and is processed together with the information stored in the associated `GlobalParameter`. This will determine how the value is parsed or displayed. For Date Global Parameters, it is in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

global\_parameter\_values\[\].  
**effective\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

A timestamp indicating when the `GlobalParameterValue` is effective from, in UTC. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

global\_parameter\_values\[\].  
**create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

A timestamp indicating when the `GlobalParameterValue` was created, in UTC. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**next\_page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token used to retrieve the next page. If empty, this returns the last page of results.

 |
| 

**previous\_page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token used to retrieve the previous page. If empty, this returns the first page of results.

 |

## [](#internal_accounts "Copy link to heading")Internal accounts

You can use internal account operations to customise the accounting model in a Vault instance. You can then replicate a business-specific chart of accounts in Vault.

In contrast to customer accounts, internal accounts reflect some operational balance for the bank. Internal account balances can, for example, be:

-   Based on some payment integration, for example, reflect a balance of some nostro account
    
-   Used by Smart Contracts to capture Profit and Loss (P & L) operations, such as charging a fee (income received in a certain internal account) or paying interest (expenditure captured in another internal account)
    

**Note:** In practice, it’s quite common for account contract templates to be empty. This is because internal accounts are subject to a high volume of transactions and often the contract hooks backing them register the movement of funds only.

### [](#internalaccount "Copy link to heading")InternalAccount

#### [](#available_methods_39 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_internal_accounts_ListInternalAccountsResponse_ListInternalAccounts) Lists all internal accounts that match the criteria used. **(Deprecated)**
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_internal_accounts_InternalAccount_CreateInternalAccount) Creates an internal account. **(Deprecated)**
    
-   [Get](#_core_api_v1_internal_accounts_InternalAccount_GetInternalAccount) Retrieves a specified internal account. **(Deprecated)**
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_internal_accounts_BatchGetInternalAccountsResponse_BatchGetInternalAccounts) Retrieves one or more internal accounts based on their IDs. **(Deprecated)**
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_internal_accounts_ListInternalAccountsResponse_ListInternalAccounts "Copy link to heading")List

**Deprecated** as of release **5.0**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0** *This method is deprecated in favour of /v2/accounts.*

Lists all internal accounts that match the criteria used.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.internal\_accounts:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/internal-accounts

internal\_accounts\[\].

enum

 |

**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_OPEN:**  
Account has been approved and transactions are allowed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
Account was previously open but is now permanently closed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Account was requested but was never approved, it is now permanently closed.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
Account was requested closure but contract and account closure are not finished.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
Account and contract record has been created, it is waiting for another call to be made open.

**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CLOSURE:**  
Account was requested closure but contract and account closure are not finished.  
**ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
Account and contract record has been created, it is waiting for another call to be made open.

## [](#journal_events "Copy link to heading")Journal Events

You can use Journal Events to detect any missed events, and replay them. For more information, see [Event reconciliation](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#event_reconciliation).

### [](#journalevent "Copy link to heading")JournalEvent

#### [](#available_methods_40 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_events_ListJournalEventsResponse_ListJournalEvents) Retrieves a page of Journal Events.
    
-   [Replay](#_core_api_v1_events_ReplayJournalEventsResponse_ReplayJournalEvents) Replays a specific set of events of a particular resource type (max batch size = 100).
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_events_ListJournalEventsResponse_ListJournalEvents "Copy link to heading")List

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.journal\_events:read

#### [](#_core_api_v1_events_ReplayJournalEventsResponse_ReplayJournalEvents "Copy link to heading")Replay

Replays a specific set of events of a particular resource type (max batch size = 100). The events will be streamed with a `X-JournalEventsBatch-ID` header value set to the `journal_events_batch_id` value returned.  
Due to the possibility of automatic retries internally, in exceptional circumstances events may also be streamed out with batch IDs other than the one returned; these should be ignored.

**Permission Scopes:** core:execute, core.journal\_events:execute

**Endpoint:** POST /v1/journal-events:replay

## [](#ledgerbalances "Copy link to heading")LedgerBalances

Use the LedgerBalances resource to query the historic balance of Internal or Customer Accounts, with respect to the time Posting Instruction Batches were inserted into the Postings Ledger (`ledger_timestamp`). For more information, see the [LedgerBalances](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/balances#ledgerbalances_resource) reference documentation.

### [](#ledgerbalance "Copy link to heading")LedgerBalance

#### [](#available_methods_42 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_ledger_balances_ListLedgerBalancesResponse_ListLedgerBalances) Lists Ledger Balances for the supplied account IDs at a specified timestamp.
    
-   [Get](#_core_api_v1_ledger_balances_LedgerBalance_GetLedgerBalance) Retrieves a Ledger Balance by ID.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_ledger_balances_ListLedgerBalancesResponse_ListLedgerBalances "Copy link to heading")List

Lists Ledger Balances for the supplied account IDs at a specified timestamp. The timestamp refers to the Postings Ledger insertion timestamp, thus a Ledger Balance is the sum of all postings up to, and including, that Postings Ledger insertion timestamp. If requesting Ledger Balances for Internal Accounts, it is recommended to send one request per Internal Account.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.ledger\_balances:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/ledger-balances

Required.

The number of results to be retrieved. Validated in the ledger balance service.

## [](#parameters "Copy link to heading")Parameters

Parameters are a way to configure Account behaviour without making changes to the underlying Smart Contract code. For more information, see [Parameters](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/parameters/).

chat\_bubble

If you are using legacy Smart Contract Instance parameters and Global parameters, ensure that you understand the process of [Switching to the Core API Parameters resource](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/parameters#switching_to_the_core_api_parameters_resource) before using the Parameters endpoints.

### [](#effectiveparametervalue "Copy link to heading")EffectiveParameterValue

#### [](#available_methods_43 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [View](#_core_api_v1_parameters_ViewEffectiveParameterValuesResponse_ViewEffectiveParameterValues) Retrieves a derived view of Parameter Values effective for a Customer Account or Parameter Value Hierarchy Node.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_parameters_ViewEffectiveParameterValuesResponse_ViewEffectiveParameterValues "Copy link to heading")View

Retrieves a derived view of Parameter Values effective for a Customer Account or Parameter Value Hierarchy Node. This view is determined considering both the inheritance and the changes made to Parameter Values over time. Can also be used to preview the effects of alternative Smart Contracts or Parameters.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.parameter\_values:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/parameter-values:viewEffective

##### [](#request_103 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of Effective Parameter Values to be returned. Maximum 1000. Required.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the requested page, which comes from a previous GET v1/parameter-values:viewEffective response. All other fields of the request must be kept the same as in the request that resulted in the page token. If empty, the first page will be returned.

 |
| 

**account\_id**  
  
string

 | 

Providing an `account_id` will return the Parameter Values effective for the Customer Account. These Parameter Values may be inherited from global or `parameter_value_hierarchy_node` owners.  
  
\- If `smart_contract_version_ids` and/or `parameter_ids` are specified on the request, Parameter Values will be returned based on these, regardless of whether they were defined in the Smart Contract Version(s) backing the Customer Account at the effective time period (`effective_timestamp`, `effective_timestamp_range`).  
  
\- If neither `smart_contract_version_ids` nor `parameter_ids` are specified, defaults to resolving the Parameter Values for all the Expected Parameters defined on the Smart Contracts' Version(s) backing the Customer Account at the effective time period.  
  
Cannot be used in conjunction with `parameter_value_hierarchy_node_id`. Either an `account_id` or a `parameter_value_hierarchy_node_id` must be provided.

 |
| 

**parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id**  
  
string

 | 

Providing a `parameter_value_hierarchy_node_id` will return the Effective Parameter Values for the Hierarchy Node. These Parameter Values may be inherited from global or ancestral `parameter_value_hierarchy_node` owners. At least one of `smart_contract_version_ids`, `parameter_ids` must be specified on the request if `parameter_value_hierarchy_node_id` is provided.  
  
Cannot be used in conjunction with `account_id`. Either an `account_id` or a `parameter_value_hierarchy_node_id` must be provided.

 |
| 

**smart\_contract\_version\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

Providing `smart_contract_version_ids` will only return the Effective Parameter Values for all the unique Expected Parameters defined in these Smart Contracts' Version(s). If used in conjunction with `parameter_ids`, a superset of Parameters will be returned. Optional.

 |
| 

**parameter\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

Providing `parameter_ids` will return the Effective Parameter Values for all of these Parameters. If used in conjunction with `smart_contract_version_id`, a superset of Parameters will be returned. Optional.

 |
| 

**effective\_timestamp**  
  
string

 | 

An effective time filter which returns Effective Parameter Values at this timestamp. If neither of the effective time filters (`effective_timestamp`, `effective_timestamp_range`) are specified, `effective_timestamp` defaults to the time the first page is processed. Cannot be used in conjunction with `effective_timestamp_range`. Must be formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision. Optional.

 |
| 

**effective\_timestamp\_range**  
  
object

 | 

An effective time filter which returns Effective Parameter Values over a specified timestamp range. This range is from `effective_timestamp_range.from` up to and not including `effective_timestamp_range.to`.  
  
\- If `effective_timestamp_range.from` is omitted, it defaults to the earliest possible timestamp.  
\- If `effective_timestamp_range.to` is omitted, it defaults to the latest possible timestamp.  
  
Cannot be used in conjunction with `effective_timestamp`. Both From and To timestamps must be formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision. Optional.

 |
| 

effective\_timestamp\_range.  
**from**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Lower end of the range. The range is inclusive of its lower end.

 |
| 

effective\_timestamp\_range.  
**to**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Upper end of the range. The range is exclusive of its upper end.

 |
| 

**snapshot\_timestamp**  
  
string

 | 

Providing a `snapshot_timestamp` will return all the Parameter Values as they were at that specific timestamp. Cannot be set in the future (greater than current time). If omitted, it defaults to the time the first page is processed. Using a `snapshot_timestamp` that is too recent (within a few seconds of the current time) may exclude concurrent updates that are still being processed. Must be formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision. Optional.  
  
**Note**: There are some important limitations to be aware of. For more information, see [Retrieving effective Parameter Values](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/parameters/building_and_managing_the_parameter_value_hierarchy#retrieving_effective_parameter_values_for_a_node) for a Parameter Value Hierarchy Node and [Retrieving effective Parameter Values for a Customer Account](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/accounts/accounts_version_2#retrieving_effective_parameter_values_for_a_customer_account).

 |

| --- | --- |

array \[object\]

**Enum values**  
**PARAMETER\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**  
**PARAMETER\_STATUS\_REQUESTED:**  
This status is only set when the Parameter ID is explicitly requested through the `parameter_ids` field and this Parameter ID is not expected in any of the `smart_contract_version_ids`.  
**PARAMETER\_STATUS\_EXPECTED:**  
This status is only set when Parameter ID is expected in any of the Smart Contracts specified in `smart_contract_version_ids`.  
**PARAMETER\_STATUS\_EXPECTED\_AT\_EFFECTIVE\_TIME:**  
This status is set when neither of the Parameter options (`smart_contract_version_ids`, `parameter_ids`) are used and the Parameter is expected by the Smart Contract Version associated with the Customer Account during this effective time.  
**PARAMETER\_STATUS\_EXPECTED\_OUTSIDE\_EFFECTIVE\_TIME:**  
This status is set when neither of the Parameter options (`smart_contract_version_ids`, `parameter_ids`) are used and the Parameter is expected by the Smart Contract Version associated with the Customer Account at some time outside this time range.

 |

parameter\_value.  
**effective\_from\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time from which the Parameter Value is effective (including this time), in UTC. Set to the current time on creation if not specified. Can be set to a time in the past if the `is_backdated` flag is set to true. Can also be set to a time in the future: see [Future-Dated Parameter Values](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/common_examples/generic#future_dated_parameter_values). Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**effective\_to\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time until which the Parameter Value remains effective (excluding this time), in UTC. If this field is left empty or omitted, the Parameter Value is effective indefinitely. Vault will automatically update this field if the Parameter Value is superseded by another Parameter Value for the same Parameter and Owner. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**effective\_to\_timestamp\_is\_explicit**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether the `effective_to_timestamp` was set explicitly using an API call or whether it was implicitly determined by Vault as a result of another Parameter Value for the same Owner superseding it. Read-only.

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**is\_backdated**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Parameter Value was a backdated change, meaning its `effective_from_timestamp` was set to a time earlier than when it was created. To allow the `effective_from_timestamp` to be in the past, this must be set to true when creating Parameter Values. A backdated Parameter Value will not trigger the [pre\_parameter\_change\_hook](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/hooks#pre_parameter_change_hook) or [post\_parameter\_change\_hook](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/hooks#post_parameter_change_hook).

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**is\_cancelled**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Parameter Value has been cancelled before it became effective. This field can be explicitly set to true via an update, providing that the `effective_from_timestamp` is in the future.

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**cancel\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time at which this Parameter Value was cancelled, in UTC. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time that the Parameter Value was created, in UTC. Read-only and set to the current time on creation. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**update\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time that the Parameter Value was last updated, in UTC. Empty if the Value was never updated. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**account\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Customer Account that owns this value.  
  
*parameter\_value can contain one of **account\_id**, global or parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id*

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**global**  
  
boolean

 | 

Whether or not this Parameter Value is globally owned. This field should be used instead of account\_config\_group\_id='root'. All Resources will use this value unless it’s overridden by a Parameter Value owned by a hierarchy or the Resource itself.  
  
*parameter\_value can contain one of account\_id, **global** or parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id*

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
parameter\_value.  
**parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Parameter Value Hierarchy Node that owns this value. Required for create requests.  
  
*parameter\_value can contain one of account\_id, global or **parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id***

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
**from\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp from the requested time range that this Parameter Value became effective for the resource (a Customer Account or a Parameter Value Hierarchy Node). It is greater than or equal to the `parameter_value.effective_from_timestamp`.

 |
| 

effective\_parameter\_values\[\].  
**to\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp from the requested time range that this Parameter Value was effective until for the resource (a Customer Account or a Parameter Value Hierarchy Node). It is lesser than or equal to the `parameter_value.effective_to_timestamp`.

 |
| 

**snapshot\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

All the Parameter Values are returned as they were at `snapshot_timestamp`. Parameter Values that have been mutated after the `snapshot_timestamp` may be incorrectly represented.

 |
| 

**next\_page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The page token which can be used to retrieve the next page of Effective Parameter Values. If empty, the given page is the last page.

 |
| 

**previous\_page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The page token which can be used to retrieve the previous page of Effective Parameter Values. If empty, the given page is the first page.

**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**

**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**

**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.

Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**

### [](#parametervalue "Copy link to heading")ParameterValue

#### [](#available_methods_45 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_parameters_ListParameterValuesResponse_ListParameterValues) Retrieves a filtered and paginated list of Parameter Values.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_parameters_ParameterValue_CreateParameterValue) Changes the value of a Parameter for a single owner at a particular point in time; this includes replacing an empty field (None) with a value.
    
-   [Update](#_core_api_v1_parameters_ParameterValue_UpdateParameterValue) Updates a Parameter Value.
    
-   [BatchCreate](#_core_api_v1_parameters_BatchCreateParameterValuesResponse_BatchCreateParameterValues) Changes the values of several Parameters for a single owner at a particular point in time; this includes replacing any empty fields (None) with values.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_parameters_BatchGetParameterValuesResponse_BatchGetParameterValues) Retrieves one or more Parameter Values by their IDs.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_parameters_ListParameterValuesResponse_ListParameterValues "Copy link to heading")List

Retrieves a filtered and paginated list of Parameter Values.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.parameter\_values:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/parameter-values

##### [](#request_107 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of Parameter Values to be returned. Maximum 100. Required.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the requested page, which comes from a previous GET v1/parameter-values response. All other fields of the request must be kept the same as the request which resulted in the page token. If empty, the first page will be returned.

 |
| 

**parameter\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

Parameter IDs to filter values on. Required.

 |
| 

**account\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

Only Parameter Values owned by the given Customer Accounts will be returned. Cannot be used with `account_config_group_ids`, `parameter_value_hierarchy_node_ids` or `global`.

 |
| 

**parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

Only Parameter Values owned by the given Parameter Value Hierarchy Nodes will be returned. Cannot be used with `account_config_group_ids`, `global` or `account_ids`.

 |
| 

**global**  
  
boolean

 | 

Only globally owned Parameter Values will be returned. Equivalent to, but should be used instead of, account\_config\_group\_ids='root'. Cannot be used with `account_config_group_ids`, `parameter_value_hierarchy_node_ids` or `account_ids`.

 |
| 

**account\_config\_group\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The only value that can return matches is `root`, which is exactly equivalent to filtering on `global` being `true`. Cannot be used with `account_ids`, `parameter_value_hierarchy_node_ids` or `global`.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.3**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*This field is replaced by `global`.*

 |
| 

**is\_cancelled**  
  
enum

 | 

Filter by the Parameter Value’s `is_cancelled` field.  
  
\- `BOTH` does not filter by `is_cancelled`.  
\- `ONLY_TRUE` returns only Parameter Values that have been cancelled.  
\- `ONLY_FALSE` returns only Parameter Values that have not been cancelled.  
  
**Enum values**  
**BOTH**  
**ONLY\_TRUE**  
**ONLY\_FALSE**  
  
**Default**  
**BOTH**

 |
| 

**effective\_timestamp\_range**  
  
object

 | 

Only values with an effective timestamp range which overlaps with the `effective_timestamp_range` will be returned. The `from` timestamps in both ranges are inclusive and the `to` timestamps in both ranges are exclusive.

 |
| 

effective\_timestamp\_range.  
**from**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Lower end of the range. The range is inclusive of its lower end.

 |
| 

effective\_timestamp\_range.  
**to**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Upper end of the range. The range is exclusive of its upper end.

 |

The time from which the Parameter Value is effective (including this time), in UTC. Set to the current time on creation if not specified. Can be set to a time in the past if the `is_backdated` flag is set to true. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

parameter\_values\[\].

dateTime

The time until which the Parameter Value remains effective (excluding this time), in UTC. If this field is left empty or omitted, the Parameter Value is effective indefinitely. Vault will automatically update this field if the Parameter Value is superseded by another Parameter Value for the same Parameter and Owner. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

boolean

#### [](#_core_api_v1_parameters_ParameterValue_CreateParameterValue "Copy link to heading")Create

Changes the value of a Parameter for a single owner at a particular point in time; this includes replacing an empty field (None) with a value. If the owner of the Parameter Value is an Account, then the [pre\_parameter\_change\_hook](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/hooks#pre_parameter_change_hook) and [post\_parameter\_change\_hook](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/hooks#post_parameter_change_hook) will run for an `INSTANCE` level `Parameter`, or an [ExpectedParameter](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/common_types_4xx/classes#ExpectedParameter) which has opted in to the hooks.  
These hooks are not run for Customer Accounts that are not yet OPEN, or if the Parameter Value is backdated.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.parameter\_values:write

**Endpoint:** POST /v1/parameter-values

**account\_id\_value**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of an Account, may be Internal or Customer.  
  
*The value of the Parameter.  
  
value can contain one of string\_value, decimal\_value, enumeration\_value, date\_time\_value or **account\_id\_value***

 |
| 

**effective\_from\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time from which the Parameter Value is effective (including this time), in UTC. Set to the current time on creation if not specified. Can be set to a time in the past if the `is_backdated` flag is set to true. Can also be set to a time in the future: see [Future-Dated Parameter Values](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/common_examples/generic#future_dated_parameter_values). Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

**effective\_to\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time until which the Parameter Value remains effective (excluding this time), in UTC. If this field is left empty or omitted, the Parameter Value is effective indefinitely. Vault will automatically update this field if the Parameter Value is superseded by another Parameter Value for the same Parameter and Owner. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

**effective\_to\_timestamp\_is\_explicit**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether the `effective_to_timestamp` was set explicitly using an API call or whether it was implicitly determined by Vault as a result of another Parameter Value for the same Owner superseding it. Read-only.

 |
| 

**is\_backdated**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Parameter Value was a backdated change, meaning its `effective_from_timestamp` was set to a time earlier than when it was created. To allow the `effective_from_timestamp` to be in the past, this must be set to true when creating Parameter Values. A backdated Parameter Value will not trigger the [pre\_parameter\_change\_hook](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/hooks#pre_parameter_change_hook) or [post\_parameter\_change\_hook](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/hooks#post_parameter_change_hook).

 |
| 

**is\_cancelled**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Parameter Value has been cancelled before it became effective. This field can be explicitly set to true via an update, providing that the `effective_from_timestamp` is in the future.

 |
| 

**cancel\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time at which this Parameter Value was cancelled, in UTC. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time that the Parameter Value was created, in UTC. Read-only and set to the current time on creation. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**update\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time that the Parameter Value was last updated, in UTC. Empty if the Value was never updated. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**account\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Customer Account that owns this value.  
  
*This can contain one of **account\_id**, global or parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id*

 |
| 

**global**  
  
boolean

 | 

Whether or not this Parameter Value is globally owned. This field should be used instead of account\_config\_group\_id='root'. All Resources will use this value unless it’s overridden by a Parameter Value owned by a hierarchy or the Resource itself.  
  
*This can contain one of account\_id, **global** or parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id*

 |
| 

**parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Parameter Value Hierarchy Node that owns this value. Required for create requests.  
  
*This can contain one of account\_id, global or **parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id***

field\_violations\[\].

string

A path leading to a field in the request body. Formatted in JSONPath, so that a 'resource' with field 'x' would return 'resource.x'.

 |
| 

field\_violations\[\].  
**violation\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Type of violation.  
  
**Enum values**  
**UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**INVALID\_FORMAT:**  
Field is not a valid format e.g. email address, UUID, IP Address, URI etc.  
**INVALID\_VALUE:**  
Indicates that a provided field is not equal to one of the specified values.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

 |
| 

field\_violations\[\].  
**description**  
  
string

 | 

A description of why the request field is invalid.

 |

#### [](#_core_api_v1_parameters_ParameterValue_UpdateParameterValue "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates a Parameter Value.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.parameter\_values:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /v1/parameter-values/{parameter\_value.id}

##### [](#request_109 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
parameter\_value.  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

Unique UUID identifier for the Parameter Value. Read-only and set to a random UUID on creation when using `POST /v1/parameter-values`. When using `POST /v1/contracts:simulate` it can optionally be specified in the request to allow the Parameter Value to be updated later in the simulation.

 |

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

A unique ID used to ensure this request is idempotent. Required.

 |
| 

**parameter\_value**  
  
object

 | 

The Parameter Value to update. The only supported updates are modifying an `effective_to_timestamp`, or setting a Parameter Value to `is_cancelled` to cancel it before it becomes effective. Parameter Values can only have their `effective_to_timestamp` set to a time in the future. Required.

 |
| 

parameter\_value.  
**effective\_to\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time until which the Parameter Value remains effective (excluding this time), in UTC. If this field is left empty or omitted, the Parameter Value is effective indefinitely. Vault will automatically update this field if the Parameter Value is superseded by another Parameter Value for the same Parameter and Owner. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

parameter\_value.  
**is\_cancelled**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Parameter Value has been cancelled before it became effective. This field can be explicitly set to true via an update, providing that the `effective_from_timestamp` is in the future.

 |
| 

**update\_mask**  
  
object

 | 

The paths of the resource to update. Values will be taken from the `parameter_value` field. The only permitted fields are `effective_to_timestamp` and `is_cancelled`. Required.

 |
| 

update\_mask.  
**paths\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The set of field mask paths.

 |
| 

**effective\_to\_timestamp\_update\_options**  
  
object

 | 

Options to define how Vault should process an update to the `effective_to_timestamp`. Options set will only take effect if `effective_to_timestamp` is included in the `update_mask`.

 |
| 

effective\_to\_timestamp\_update\_options.  
**set\_to\_now**  
  
boolean

 | 

This controls the behaviour when a request is sent to update the `effective_to_timestamp` but no value is set in `parameter_value.effective_to_timestamp`. When set to true, Vault immediately unsets the Parameter Value by setting its `effective_to_timestamp` to the time that Vault processes the request. This is an alternative to explicitly setting a near-future `effective_to_timestamp`, which could inadvertently be in the past by the time of processing. When set to false, or if this update option is omitted, the `effective_to_timestamp` will be left unbounded or set to the `effective_from_timestamp` of the next Parameter Value in the timeseries.

 |
| 

**is\_cancelled\_update\_options**  
  
object

 | 

Options to define how Vault should process the cancellation of the Parameter Value. Options set will only take effect if the request cancels the Parameter Value.

 |
| 

is\_cancelled\_update\_options.  
**skip\_pre\_parameter\_change\_hook**  
  
boolean

 | 

Do not run the Smart Contract’s pre parameter change hook for this Parameter Value update.

 |

string

 | 

The ID of the Account Config Group that owns this value. Can only be set to `root`, and is exactly equivalent to setting `global` to `true`. Functionality originally intended for this field has now moved to `parameter_value_hierarchy_node_id`.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.3**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*This field is replaced by `global`. Prior to removal of this field, if this field is populated it will be set to `root`, and `global` will also be set to `true`.*

 |

object

value.

string

 |

 |

 |

value can contain one of string\_value, decimal\_value, enumeration\_value, date\_time\_value or **account\_id\_value***

 |
| 

**effective\_from\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time from which the Parameter Value is effective (including this time), in UTC. Set to the current time on creation if not specified. Can be set to a time in the past if the `is_backdated` flag is set to true. Can also be set to a time in the future: see [Future-Dated Parameter Values](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/common_examples/generic#future_dated_parameter_values). Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

**effective\_to\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time until which the Parameter Value remains effective (excluding this time), in UTC. If this field is left empty or omitted, the Parameter Value is effective indefinitely. Vault will automatically update this field if the Parameter Value is superseded by another Parameter Value for the same Parameter and Owner. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp. Will be truncated to microsecond precision.

 |
| 

**effective\_to\_timestamp\_is\_explicit**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether the `effective_to_timestamp` was set explicitly using an API call or whether it was implicitly determined by Vault as a result of another Parameter Value for the same Owner superseding it. Read-only.

 |
| 

**is\_backdated**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Parameter Value was a backdated change, meaning its `effective_from_timestamp` was set to a time earlier than when it was created. To allow the `effective_from_timestamp` to be in the past, this must be set to true when creating Parameter Values. A backdated Parameter Value will not trigger the [pre\_parameter\_change\_hook](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/hooks#pre_parameter_change_hook) or [post\_parameter\_change\_hook](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/contracts/contracts_api_4xx/smart_contracts_api_reference4xx/hooks#post_parameter_change_hook).

 |
| 

**is\_cancelled**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates whether this Parameter Value has been cancelled before it became effective. This field can be explicitly set to true via an update, providing that the `effective_from_timestamp` is in the future.

 |
| 

**cancel\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time at which this Parameter Value was cancelled, in UTC. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time that the Parameter Value was created, in UTC. Read-only and set to the current time on creation. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**update\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time that the Parameter Value was last updated, in UTC. Empty if the Value was never updated. Formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

 |
| 

**account\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Customer Account that owns this value.  
  
*This can contain one of **account\_id**, global or parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id*

 |
| 

**global**  
  
boolean

 | 

Whether or not this Parameter Value is globally owned. This field should be used instead of account\_config\_group\_id='root'. All Resources will use this value unless it’s overridden by a Parameter Value owned by a hierarchy or the Resource itself.  
  
*This can contain one of account\_id, **global** or parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id*

 |
| 

**parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Parameter Value Hierarchy Node that owns this value. Required for create requests.  
  
*This can contain one of account\_id, global or **parameter\_value\_hierarchy\_node\_id***
