**POSTINGS\_API\_TYPE\_LOW\_PRIORITY:**  
Indicates that the request will be submitted to the low-priority Postings API.  
  
**Default**  
**POSTINGS\_API\_TYPE\_HIGH\_PRIORITY**

#### [](#_core_api_v1_posting_instruction_batches_BatchGetPostingInstructionBatchesResponse_BatchGetPostingInstructionBatches "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves one or more posting instruction batches by ID.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.posting\_instruction\_batches:read

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/posting-instruction-batches:batchGet

##### [](#request_150 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

A list of IDs of posting instruction batches to retrieve. Required; must be non-empty.  
This field must contain a valid UUID in the canonical 8-4-4-4-12 form.  
Required.

 |

**POSTING\_VIOLATION\_CLIENT\_TRANSACTION\_ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
An OutboundAuthorisation, InboundAuthorisation, Transfer, OutboundHardSettlement or InboundHardSettlement specifies a `client_transaction_id` which already exists in the namespace of the `client_id`.  
**POSTING\_VIOLATION\_CLIENT\_TRANSACTION\_DOES\_NOT\_EXIST:**

**POSTING\_VIOLATION\_CLIENT\_TRANSACTION\_INVALID\_OPERATION:**

posting\_instruction\_batches\[KEY\].  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
**booking\_localised\_date\_time**  
  
string

 | 

An RFC 3339 compliant date/time string representing the `booking_timestamp` of the PostingInstructionBatch, localised into the time zone of the processing group associated with accounts referenced in this PostingInstruction. As the processing group may change over time, this field will not be populated for future-booked postings.

 |
| 

posting\_instruction\_batches\[KEY\].  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
**value\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Specifies the time at which all committed postings of this PostingInstruction will affect balances. For most cases, including real time payments or fund movements, this does not require setting and will default to the generated `insertion_timestamp`. Should only be set for backdated and future-dated instructions and must be between 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z and the current time + 90 calendar days, inclusive. Defaults to the `insertion_timestamp` in UTC.

 |
| 

posting\_instruction\_batches\[KEY\].  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
**booking\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Specifies the time at which all committed postings of this PostingInstruction will be booked. For most cases, including real time payments or fund movements, this does not require setting and will default to the `insertion_timestamp`. Should only be set for back-booked and future-booked instructions and must be between 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z and the current time + 90 calendar days, inclusive. Defaults to the `insertion_timestamp` in UTC.

 |

dateTime

dateTime

 | 

Specifies the time the posting instruction was inserted in the source core banking engine. Will always have the same value as `insertion_timestamp` unless posting instruction was migrated into Vault via the Posting Migration API.

posting\_instruction\_batches\[KEY\].

**amount**  
  
string

 | 

A delta amount. The sign of the delta can be given explicitly (`"+3.40"`, `"-20"`) or implicitly if it is positive (e.g "3.40" is the same as "+3.40").  
  
*The amount of the AuthorisationAdjustment, which can be specified as a delta (the difference between the previous amount and the new amount) or as a new total authorised amount. On a response, it is recommended to inspect the `delta_amount` and `authorised_amount` fields as they contain the same information but, unlike the `adjustment_amount.amount` or `adjustment_amount.replacement_amount` fields, they are guaranteed to be set on an accepted PostingInstructionBatch.  
  
authorisation\_adjustment can contain one of **amount** or replacement\_amount*

 |
|

authorisation\_adjustment.  
**replacement\_amount**  
  
string

 |

*The amount of the AuthorisationAdjustment, which can be specified as a delta (the difference between the previous amount and the new amount) or as a new total authorised amount. On a response, it is recommended to inspect the `delta_amount` and `authorised_amount` fields as they contain the same information but, unlike the `adjustment_amount.amount` or `adjustment_amount.replacement_amount` fields, they are guaranteed to be set on an accepted PostingInstructionBatch.  
  
authorisation\_adjustment can contain one of amount or **replacement\_amount***

custom\_instruction.  
postings\[\].  
**internal\_account\_processing\_label**  
  
string

 | 

You can use a processing label to specify an Internal Account as part of a Custom Instruction instead of directly referencing an account ID. If you use a processing label in a CustomInstruction, there must be at least one posting in the same instruction that does not use a label, using the account\_id instead. The internal account then resolves using the processing group of the account identified by this account\_id. If a posting of a CustomInstruction using a processing label does not contain an account\_id, this request will fail. You also cannot instruct a CustomInstruction in which labels are used in all its postings.  
  
**Multiple Processing Groups are only available as an Extension.**

 |

posting\_instruction\_batches\[KEY\].  
**batch\_details**  
  
map \[string: string\]

 | 

Stores metadata related to the posting instruction batch resource. These details can also be retrieved in the posting instruction resource. Optional.

 |
| 

posting\_instruction\_batches\[KEY\].  
**value\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Specifies the time at which all committed postings of this batch’s posting instructions will affect balances. For most cases, including real time payments or fund movements, this does not require setting and will default to the generated `insertion_timestamp`. Only backdating of posting instruction batches is supported; this means that you cannot set them to be in the future, as determined by the clock of the ledger service. The earliest allowed value is 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Optional; defaults to the insertion timestamp in UTC.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.5**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*This field is replaced by the value\_timestamp in the PostingInstruction. Deprecated only in the Postings API - not deprecated in the Postings Migration API.*

 |
| 

posting\_instruction\_batches\[KEY\].  
**booking\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Optional. Specifies the booking time of all committed postings of this batch’s Posting Instructions. Defaults to `value_timestamp` (which, in turn, defaults to `insertion_timestamp`). Can only be used for back-booked Posting Instruction Batches (PIBs), and can only be set if `value_timestamp` is also passed in the request; in which case `booking_timestamp` must be later than `value_timestamp`.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.5**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*This field is replaced by the booking\_timestamp in the PostingInstruction. Deprecated only in the Postings API - not deprecated in the Postings Migration API.*

 |
| 

posting\_instruction\_batches\[KEY\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the processing of the posting instruction batch.  
  
**Enum values**  
**POSTING\_INSTRUCTION\_BATCH\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**POSTING\_INSTRUCTION\_BATCH\_STATUS\_ACCEPTED:**  
The PostingInstructionBatch has been accepted and Postings have been committed to the ledger.  
**POSTING\_INSTRUCTION\_BATCH\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The PostingInstructionBatch has been rejected and no Postings have been committed to the ledger.

 |

enum

The type of error returned.  
  
**Enum values**  
**POSTING\_INSTRUCTION\_BATCH\_ERROR\_TYPE\_INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
CreatePostingInstructionBatchRequest contains invalid arguments and the request cannot be processed. See the error message for more details. Cannot Retry.  
**POSTING\_INSTRUCTION\_BATCH\_ERROR\_TYPE\_INTERNAL:**  
An internal error occurred due to unexpected condition while processing the request. Can Retry.  
**POSTING\_INSTRUCTION\_BATCH\_ERROR\_TYPE\_TTL\_EXPIRED:**  
A time to live expiry error occured because the requested `time_to_live` timestamp has expired. Cannot Retry.

## [](#postings_api_clients "Copy link to heading")Postings API clients

Use the Postings API clients resource to create the payment integrations and routes through which low (and high if required) priority Kafka Postings requests and responses travel. For more information, see the [Postings API documentation](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/postings_api/).

### [](#postingsapiclient "Copy link to heading")PostingsAPIClient

#### [](#available_methods_59 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_postings_api_clients_ListPostingsAPIClientsResponse_ListPostingsAPIClients) Gets a list of all `PostingsAPIClient`s.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_postings_api_clients_PostingsAPIClient_CreatePostingsAPIClient) Creates and returns a specified `PostingsAPIClient`.
    
-   [Get](#_core_api_v1_postings_api_clients_PostingsAPIClient_GetPostingsAPIClient) Gets a `PostingsAPIClient` for the given `id`.
    
-   [Update](#_core_api_v1_postings_api_clients_PostingsAPIClient_UpdatePostingsAPIClient) Updates an existing `PostingsAPIClient` with a new `response_topic_low_priority`.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_postings_api_clients_BatchGetPostingsAPIClientsResponse_BatchGetPostingsAPIClients) Gets a map of `id` to `PostingsAPIClient` for a given set of `id`s.

#### [](#_core_api_v1_postings_api_clients_PostingsAPIClient_CreatePostingsAPIClient "Copy link to heading")Create

Creates and returns a specified `PostingsAPIClient`.

**Note**: You cannot update the response topic after the client has been created.

If the low priority topic does not already exist in the Kafka cluster, it is automatically created during client setup.

lightbulb

#### [](#_core_api_v1_postings_api_clients_PostingsAPIClient_UpdatePostingsAPIClient "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates an existing `PostingsAPIClient` with a new `response_topic_low_priority`.

error

Changing the low priority topic does not migrate existing messages, and messages may not fully switch over immediately.

**Note**: It may take up to five minutes for responses to be streamed on the updated response topic.

If the low priority topic does not already exist in the Kafka cluster, it is automatically created during client setup.

lightbulb

You can disable Vault-side Kafka topic management by setting the `kafka.topics.disable_vault_topic_management` option in the values.yaml file to `true`.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.postings\_api\_clients:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /v1/postings-api-clients/{postings\_api\_client.id}

#### [](#available_methods_60 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_processing_groups_ListProcessingGroupsResponse_ListProcessingGroups) ListProcessingGroups retrieves all Processing Groups.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_processing_groups_ProcessingGroup_CreateProcessingGroup) CreateProcessingGroup creates a single processing group.
    
-   [Get](#_core_api_v1_processing_groups_ProcessingGroup_GetProcessingGroup) GetProcessingGroup retrieves a single Processing Group by ID.
    
-   [Update](#_core_api_v1_processing_groups_ProcessingGroup_UpdateProcessingGroup) UpdateProcessingGroup updates a single Processing Group.

#### [](#_core_api_v1_processing_groups_ProcessingGroup_UpdateProcessingGroup "Copy link to heading")Update

UpdateProcessingGroup updates a single Processing Group.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.processing\_groups:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /v1/processing-groups/{processing\_group.id}

##### [](#request_159 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
processing\_group.  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

A unique ID for the Processing Group. Optional for create requests. The '/' character is not supported in the ID.

 |

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

A unique string ID used to ensure the request is idempotent.  
  
Required.  
Max length: 512 characters.

 |
| 

**processing\_group**  
  
object

 | 

The processing group to be updated.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

processing\_group.  
**timezone**  
  
string

 | 

The time zone of the Processing Group. **Warning: It is critical that you set this correctly because once set, it cannot be changed.** For more information, see [Processing Groups](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/processing_groups/).

 |
| 

processing\_group.  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the Processing Group. Default: PROCESSING\_GROUP\_STATUS\_ACTIVE. On creation read only.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_GROUP\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Unset value.  
**PROCESSING\_GROUP\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
All schedules in the Processing Group will run as normal.  
**PROCESSING\_GROUP\_STATUS\_PAUSED:**  
Execution of schedules for this Processing Group will be paused.  
  
**Default**  
**PROCESSING\_GROUP\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

processing\_group.  
**description**  
  
string

 | 

The description of the Processing Group. Optional.

 |
| 

**update\_mask**  
  
object

 | 

Field mask that indicates which fields of the resource are to be updated. Valid update paths are "status", "timezone" and "description". "status" updates a processing group’s status between PROCESSING\_GROUP\_STATUS\_ACTIVE and PROCESSING\_GROUP\_STATUS\_PAUSED. "timezone" can only be set once for the default processing group.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

update\_mask.  
**paths\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The set of field mask paths.

 |
| 

**minimum\_observation\_timestamp\_update\_options**  
  
object

 | 

Determines whether or not the minimum\_observation\_timestamp should be set. Optional. If not provided, no updates will be made to the minimum\_observation\_timestamp.

 |
| 

minimum\_observation\_timestamp\_update\_options.  
**schedules\_observe\_balances\_at\_unpause\_time**  
  
boolean

 | 

Boolean to be used if requirements fetched for contract execution balance should be observed after a processing group is unpaused. If it is set to true, the minimum\_observation\_timestamp will be updated to the unpause time. If it is false, the minimum\_observation\_timestamp will be set to nil.

 |

## [](#products "Copy link to heading")Products

Used to specify behaviours and rules for customer accounts. Each type of customer account has a product associated with it. Information about an account type, including the Smart Contracts code used to implement it, is specified using the product version. A number of different versions may exist for each product but the version designated as current is used by default when a customer opens a new account.

These endpoints let you:

-   Create products and product versions
    
-   Specify which product version is current
    
-   Indicate whether the product is available to customers or is for internal use only
    

### [](#product "Copy link to heading")Product

#### [](#available_methods_61 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_products_ListProductsResponse_ListProducts) Lists products with pagination.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_products_BatchGetProductsResponse_BatchGetProducts) Retrieves one or more products using the product IDs specified.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_products_ListProductsResponse_ListProducts "Copy link to heading")List

Lists products with pagination.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.products:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/products

##### [](#request_160 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters

| --- | --- |
| 
**include\_internality**  
  
enum

 | 

Whether to include internal and/or external Products in the results.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INTERNALITY\_REFINER\_ANY\_INTERNALITY:**  
Default. Lists both internal and external products.  
**INTERNALITY\_REFINER\_INTERNAL:**  
Lists internal products only.  
**INTERNALITY\_REFINER\_EXTERNAL:**  
Lists external products only.  
  
**Default**  
**INTERNALITY\_REFINER\_ANY\_INTERNALITY**

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be listed. Required.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 30.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, returns the first page of results. Optional.

### [](#productversion "Copy link to heading")ProductVersion

#### [](#available_methods_62 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_products_ListProductVersionsResponse_ListProductVersions) Lists the versions of a product with pagination.
    
-   [Create](#_core_api_v1_products_ProductVersion_CreateProductVersion) Creates a product version and product.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_products_BatchGetProductVersionsResponse_BatchGetProductVersions) Retrieves one or more product versions using the product version IDs specified.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_products_ListProductVersionsResponse_ListProductVersions "Copy link to heading")List

Lists the versions of a product with pagination.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.product\_versions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/product-versions

##### [](#request_162 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**product\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The product ID that product versions are to be listed for. Required.

 |
| 

**view**  
  
enum

 | 

Indicates which fields should be included in the Product Versions. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_BASIC:**  
Excludes tags, contract parameters and source code associated with the Product Version.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_INCLUDE\_TAGS:**  
Includes the basic view and tags associated with the Product Version.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_INCLUDE\_PARAMETERS:**  
Includes the tags view and contract parameters associated with the Product Version.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_INCLUDE\_CODE:**  
Includes all fields. Due to the size of smart contract code, this view has a high chance of returning a Resource Exhausted (429) error. To resolve this, try reducing the number of requested Product Versions by reducing the page size or number of IDs.  
  
**Default**  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_BASIC**

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be listed. Required.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 30.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, returns the first page of results. Optional.

 |

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.product\_versions:write

**Endpoint:** POST /v1/product-versions

Default value.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_CORE\_TAG\_DEPOSIT:**  
Tags the product version as a single deposit.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_CORE\_TAG\_FIXED\_TERM\_DEPOSIT:**  
Tags the product version as several deposits over a fixed term.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_CORE\_TAG\_SAVING:**  
Tags the product as a savings product.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_CORE\_TAG\_LOAN:**  
Tags the product as a loan.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_CORE\_TAG\_CREDIT:**  
Tags the product as a credit product.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_CORE\_TAG\_MORTGAGE:**  
Tags the product as a mortgage.

**migration\_strategy**  
  
enum

 | 

The migration strategy for applying the new version. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_MIGRATION\_STRATEGY\_UNKNOWN:**  
The migration strategy is not known. This is not a valid strategy for internal products. Defaults to `PRODUCT_VERSION_MIGRATION_STRATEGY_NEW_PRODUCT`.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_MIGRATION\_STRATEGY\_NEW\_PRODUCT:**  
Creates a new product and initial product version, returning an error if the product already exists. This is a valid strategy for internal products.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_MIGRATION\_STRATEGY\_ADD\_VERSION:**  
Creates a new product version, returning an error if the product does not exist. This strategy does not update the current version of the product. Existing accounts on this product are not migrated to this product version. This is not a valid strategy for internal products.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_MIGRATION\_STRATEGY\_ADD\_VERSION\_APPLY\_NEW\_USERS:**  
Creates a new product version, returning an error if the product does not exist. This strategy updates the current version of the product to this product version. Existing accounts on this product are not migrated to this product version. This is not a valid strategy for internal products.  
  
**Default**  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_MIGRATION\_STRATEGY\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

**is\_internal**  
  
boolean

 | 

When creating a new product, used to indicate if the new product is for internal accounts only and not available to customers.

#### [](#_core_api_v1_products_BatchGetProductVersionsResponse_BatchGetProductVersions "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves one or more product versions using the product version IDs specified.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.product\_versions:read

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/product-versions:batchGet

##### [](#request_164 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

A list of the IDs of the product versions to be retrieved. Required; must be non-empty.

 |
| 

**view**  
  
enum

 | 

Indicates which fields should be included for the Product Versions. Optional; default is basic view.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_BASIC:**  
Excludes tags, contract parameters and source code associated with the Product Version.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_INCLUDE\_TAGS:**  
Includes the basic view and tags associated with the Product Version.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_INCLUDE\_PARAMETERS:**  
Includes the tags view and contract parameters associated with the Product Version.  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_INCLUDE\_CODE:**  
Includes all fields. Due to the size of smart contract code, this view has a high chance of returning a Resource Exhausted (429) error. To resolve this, try reducing the number of requested Product Versions by reducing the page size or number of IDs.  
  
**Default**  
**PRODUCT\_VERSION\_VIEW\_BASIC**

 |

### [](#productversionparam "Copy link to heading")ProductVersionParam

#### [](#available_methods_63 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Update](#_core_api_v1_products_ProductVersion_UpdateProductVersionParams) Updates the value of one or more parameters for a product version.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_products_ProductVersion_UpdateProductVersionParams "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates the value of one or more parameters for a product version.

To add one or more parameter values at a new effective timestamp, each parameter in the `items_to_add` field must have its `name` and `value` populated. The `effective_timestamp` is optional, but must not be in the past, and defaults to current time. The new parameter(s) will be added to the product version parameter timeseries. An error will be raised if the `items_to_add` field is populated with a parameter with an existing `name` and `effective_timestamp`. An error will be raised during execution if the `shape` of the `value` does not match the existing parameter `shape`. There is no parse-time validation to check the `shape`.

To remove one or more parameter values at existing effective timestamps, you must populate the `items_to_remove` field with `name` and `value` for each parameter. The`effective_timestamp` must not be in the past. The `value` of the parameter is ignored. Specifying `items_to_remove` deletes these parameter(s) from the product version parameter timeseries. If the `items_to_remove` field is populated with `name` and `effective_timestamp` parameters that do not already exist in the product version parameter timeseries, this generates an error.

To edit the `value` of one or more parameters with an effective\_timestamp set to a time in the future, the request must be sent with the `items_to_remove` and `items_to_add` fields populated. The `items_to_remove` field requires a list of existing parameters with the `name` and `effective_timestamp` fields populated. The `items_to_add field` requires a list of parameters with the `name` and `effective_timestamp` fields populated. The `value` field of the parameter(s) must be populated with the desired end value. The name and effective\_timestamp of a parameter in the items\_to\_add field must exactly match the corresponding parameter in the items\_to\_remove field if the parameter’s `value` is to be updated.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.product\_versions:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /v1/product-versions/{product\_version\_id}:updateParams

 | 

A unique string ID used to ensure the request is idempotent.  
  
Required.  
Max length: 512 characters.

 |
| 

**items\_to\_add\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

A list of parameters that are to be added to the product version parameter timeseries. Each parameter in the `items_to_add` field must have its `name` and `value` populated. The `effective_timestamp` is optional and will default to current time. If set, the `effective_timestamp` must be formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp and must not be in the past.  
  
When editing the value of one or more parameter(s), each parameter in `items_to_add` must correspond to a parameter in `items_to_remove` with a matching `name` and `effective_timestamp`.

The `effective_timestamp` must be an RFC3339 timestamp and must not be in the past. The `value` of the parameter(s) is ignored. If the `items_to_remove` field is populated with a parameter `name` and `effective_timestamp` that do not already exist in the product version parameter, this generates an error.  
  
When editing the value of one or more parameter(s), each parameter in `items_to_remove` must correspond to a parameter in `items_to_add` with a matching `name` and `effective_timestamp`.

## [](#restrictions "Copy link to heading")Restrictions

The Restrictions endpoints provide a rich framework to enforce certain custom business rules by using a blocking mechanism. The mechanism can be used to handle judicial court orders, AML regulations, payment scheme compliance, security alerts or any other access control limitation scenarios.

Vault Core exposes a predefined set of restriction primitives which are enforced in several places. They can be used to prevent, put for review, limit debits and credits, prevent any customers or a specific customer from mutating or opening a Customer Account, or to block posting initiation for a certain payment device.

### [](#primitive_restrictions "Copy link to heading")Primitive Restrictions

For each restriction, you must specify the following:

-   `type`: The [restriction type](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#restriction_types)
    
-   `level`: The [level](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#level_types) at which the restriction applies
    

#### [](#restriction_types "Copy link to heading")Restriction types

 
| Restriction type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
PREVENT\_CREDITS

 | 

Prevents any credits.

 |
| 

REVIEW\_CREDITS

 | 

Requires reviewing of any credits.

 |
| 

PREVENT\_DEBITS

 | 

Prevents any debits.

 |
| 

REVIEW\_DEBITS

 | 

Requires reviewing of any debits.

 |
| 

PREVENT\_CLOSURE

 | 

Prevents closing a customer, account or payment device.

 |
| 

PREVENT\_OPENING

 | 

Prevents opening a customer, account or payment device.

 |
| 

LIMIT\_DEBITS

 | 

Limits debits being made by a customer, account or payment device.

 |
| 

LIMIT\_CREDITS

 | 

Limits credits being made by a customer, account or payment device.

 |
| 

PREVENT\_UPDATES

 | 

Prevents updating a customer, account or payment device.

**Note**: This prevents account updates via [PUT /v1/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount) or [PUT /v2/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount). It does not prevent account updates via [POST /v1/account-updates](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_AccountUpdate_CreateAccountUpdate).

 |
| 

PREVENT\_ACCOUNT\_CREATION

 | 

Prevents a customer from applying for any accounts, and from being added as a new stakeholder when updating an account.

 |

#### [](#level_types "Copy link to heading")Level types

 
| Level type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
`customer_id`

 | 

Restrict a customer.

 |
| 

`account_id`

 | 

Restrict a customer account.

 |
| 

`payment_device_id`

 | 

Restrict a payment device.

 |

A customer is the highest level where a restriction can be applied, followed by a customer account and then payment device.

For example, applying a restriction at the `customer_id` level will restrict all accounts for that customer and all the accounts and payment devices that are associated with that customer. Defining a restriction at the `payment_device_level` will restrict the specific payment device, but other payment devices or postings for that account will not be affected by the restriction.

#### [](#examples "Copy link to heading")Examples

 
| Restriction type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
PREVENT\_DEBITS with level \[CUSTOMER\]

 | 

Prevents any debits for a specific customer.

 |
| 

PREVENT\_DEBITS with level \[ACCOUNT\]

 | 

Prevents all debits from a customer account.

 |
| 

PREVENT\_DEBITS with level \[PAYMENT\_DEVICE\]

 | 

Prevents debits from all customer accounts associated with the given payment device.

 |

### [](#creating_restrictions "Copy link to heading")Creating Restrictions

To create restrictions, depending on the required levels of the definition, first [create a RestrictionSet](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_restrictions_RestrictionSet_CreateRestrictionSet) with at least one level:

-   `customer_id`
    
-   `account_id`
    
-   `payment_device_id`
    

Then, [create a RestrictionSetDefinitionVersion](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_restrictions_RestrictionSetDefinitionVersion_CreateRestrictionSetDefinitionVersion) with the restriction type and level:

-   `restriction_type`
    
-   `required_restriction_levels`
    

[RestrictionSets](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#restrictionset) and [RestrictionSetDefinitions](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#restrictionsetdefinition) group together multiple primitive restrictions and primitive restriction definitions in order to allow the enforcement of a full business scenario at once.

lightbulb

[RestrictionSetDefinitions](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#restrictionsetdefinition) are versioned in order to allow the bank to adapt to changing requirements, and there is always a current version for a restriction set definition.

### [](#applying_restrictions "Copy link to heading")Applying Restrictions

To apply restrictions, instantiate a [RestrictionSetDefinitionVersion](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#restrictionsetdefinitionversion) with all required levels and parameters. This creates a restriction set resource that forwards its parameters to the primitive restrictions that it defines.

### [](#restriction "Copy link to heading")Restriction

#### [](#available_methods_65 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.restrictions:read

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/restrictions

Response fields

| 
**restrictions\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 |

 |
| 

restrictions\[\].  
**restriction\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Enum value indicating which [restriction type](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#restriction_types) this applies to.  
  
**Enum values**  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown restriction type. There are no enforced combinations.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction type that prevents credits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from receiving credits  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from receiving credits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits using this payment device.  
  
**Optional argument**: `"prevent_credits_exemption_conditions"` Defines arbitrary key-value pairs, which, if they are all present in the `posting_instructions[].instruction_details` field of a Posting Instruction batch, will allow the restriction to be bypassed.  
  
This parameter must be formatted as a JSON string with one or more key-value pairs. For example, to prevent credits on an account except when the debtor account number is "1234", set the parameter to: `{"debtor_account_number":"1234"}`  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_REVIEW\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction type that will require reviewing credits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Forces a review of credits for an account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Forces a review of credits for a payment device.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that prevents debits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents debits for the customer.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents debits for the customer on a specific account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents debits for the account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents debits for the payment device.  
  
**Optional argument**: `"prevent_credits_exemption_conditions"` Defines arbitrary key-value pairs, which, if they are all present in the `posting_instructions[].instruction_details` field of a Posting Instruction batch, will allow the restriction to be bypassed.  
  
This parameter must be formatted as a JSON string with one or more key-value pairs. For example, to prevent credits on an account except when the debtor account number is "1234", set the parameter to: `{"debtor_account_number":"1234"}`  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_REVIEW\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that requires reviewing debits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Forces a review of customer debits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Forces a review of account debits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Forces a review of payment device debits.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_CLOSURE:**  
A restriction type that prevents closing a customer, account or payment device. Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents all stakeholders from closing the account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from being made inactive.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_OPENING:**  
A restriction type that prevents opening a customer, account or payment device. Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents an account from being approved  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents a payment device from being made active  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that limits debits being made by a customer, account or payment device. Applies to individual posting amounts, not a cumulative amount across one or more postings.  
  
**Required arguments**: `limit_debits_amount` and `limit_debits_currency` must be included as part of `restriction_set_parameters` when creating a restriction set.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Limits the debits the customer can make to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Limits the debits the customer can make from an account to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Limits the debits the account can make to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Limits the debits the payment device can make to the specified amount.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction type that limits credits for a customer, account or payment device. Applies to individual posting amounts, not a cumulative amount across one or more postings.  
  
**Required arguments**: `limit_credits_amount` and `limit_credits_currency` must be included as part of the `restriction_set_parameters` when creating a restriction set.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_UPDATES:**  
A restriction type that prevents updating a customer, account or payment device.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from being updated.  
  
**Note**: `[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]` prevents account updates via [PUT /v1/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount) or [PUT /v2/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount). It does not prevent account updates via [POST /v1/account-updates](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_AccountUpdate_CreateAccountUpdate).  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_ACCOUNT\_CREATION:**  
A restriction type that prevents a customer from applying for any accounts, and from being added as a new stakeholder when updating an account. A stakeholder with a restriction of this type can be removed from the stakeholder list.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from applying for any accounts.

`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits using this payment device.  
  
**Optional argument**: `"prevent_credits_exemption_conditions"` Defines arbitrary key-value pairs, which, if they are all present in the `posting_instructions[].instruction_details` field of a Posting Instruction batch, will allow the restriction to be bypassed.  
  
This parameter must be formatted as a JSON string with one or more key-value pairs. For example, to prevent credits on an account except when the debtor account number is "1234", set the parameter to: `{"debtor_account_number":"1234"}`  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_REVIEW\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction type that will require reviewing credits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Forces a review of credits for an account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Forces a review of credits for a payment device.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that prevents debits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents debits for the customer.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents debits for the customer on a specific account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents debits for the account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents debits for the payment device.  
  
**Optional argument**: `"prevent_credits_exemption_conditions"` Defines arbitrary key-value pairs, which, if they are all present in the `posting_instructions[].instruction_details` field of a Posting Instruction batch, will allow the restriction to be bypassed.  
  
This parameter must be formatted as a JSON string with one or more key-value pairs. For example, to prevent credits on an account except when the debtor account number is "1234", set the parameter to: `{"debtor_account_number":"1234"}`  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_REVIEW\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that requires reviewing debits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Forces a review of customer debits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Forces a review of account debits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Forces a review of payment device debits.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_CLOSURE:**  
A restriction type that prevents closing a customer, account or payment device. Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents all stakeholders from closing the account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from being made inactive.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_OPENING:**  
A restriction type that prevents opening a customer, account or payment device. Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents an account from being approved  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents a payment device from being made active  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that limits debits being made by a customer, account or payment device. Applies to individual posting amounts, not a cumulative amount across one or more postings.  
  
**Required arguments**: `limit_debits_amount` and `limit_debits_currency` must be included as part of `restriction_set_parameters` when creating a restriction set.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Limits the debits the customer can make to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Limits the debits the customer can make from an account to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Limits the debits the account can make to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Limits the debits the payment device can make to the specified amount.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction type that limits credits for a customer, account or payment device. Applies to individual posting amounts, not a cumulative amount across one or more postings.  
  
**Required arguments**: `limit_credits_amount` and `limit_credits_currency` must be included as part of the `restriction_set_parameters` when creating a restriction set.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_UPDATES:**  
A restriction type that prevents updating a customer, account or payment device.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from being updated.  
  
**Note**: `[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]` prevents account updates via [PUT /v1/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount) or [PUT /v2/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount). It does not prevent account updates via [POST /v1/account-updates](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_AccountUpdate_CreateAccountUpdate).  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_ACCOUNT\_CREATION:**  
A restriction type that prevents a customer from applying for any accounts, and from being added as a new stakeholder when updating an account. A stakeholder with a restriction of this type can be removed from the stakeholder list.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from applying for any accounts.

`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from being made inactive.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_OPENING:**  
A restriction type that prevents opening a customer, account or payment device. Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents an account from being approved  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents a payment device from being made active  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that limits debits being made by a customer, account or payment device. Applies to individual posting amounts, not a cumulative amount across one or more postings.  
  
**Required arguments**: `limit_debits_amount` and `limit_debits_currency` must be included as part of `restriction_set_parameters` when creating a restriction set.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Limits the debits the customer can make to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Limits the debits the customer can make from an account to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Limits the debits the account can make to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Limits the debits the payment device can make to the specified amount.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction type that limits credits for a customer, account or payment device. Applies to individual posting amounts, not a cumulative amount across one or more postings.  
  
**Required arguments**: `limit_credits_amount` and `limit_credits_currency` must be included as part of the `restriction_set_parameters` when creating a restriction set.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_UPDATES:**  
A restriction type that prevents updating a customer, account or payment device.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from being updated.  
  
**Note**: `[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]` prevents account updates via [PUT /v1/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount) or [PUT /v2/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount). It does not prevent account updates via [POST /v1/account-updates](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_AccountUpdate_CreateAccountUpdate).  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_ACCOUNT\_CREATION:**  
A restriction type that prevents a customer from applying for any accounts, and from being added as a new stakeholder when updating an account. A stakeholder with a restriction of this type can be removed from the stakeholder list.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from applying for any accounts.

#### [](#_core_api_v1_restrictions_ListRestrictionSetDefinitionVersionsResponse_ListRestrictionSetDefinitionVersions "Copy link to heading")List

Lists all the restriction set definition versions sorted by name. This list method does not support pagination, as we believe it will never reach a point where pagination is required, even after many years of use. The restriction set definition versions are sorted by creation time from earliest to latest.

`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_UPDATES:**  
A restriction type that prevents updating a customer, account or payment device.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from being updated.  
  
**Note**: `[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]` prevents account updates via [PUT /v1/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount) or [PUT /v2/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount). It does not prevent account updates via [POST /v1/account-updates](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_AccountUpdate_CreateAccountUpdate).  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_ACCOUNT\_CREATION:**  
A restriction type that prevents a customer from applying for any accounts, and from being added as a new stakeholder when updating an account. A stakeholder with a restriction of this type can be removed from the stakeholder list.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from applying for any accounts.

#### [](#_core_api_v1_restrictions_RestrictionSetDefinitionVersion_CreateRestrictionSetDefinitionVersion "Copy link to heading")Create

Creates a restriction set definition version. This creates the restriction set definition if it does not exist.

**Permission Scopes:** core:write, core.restriction\_set\_definition\_versions:write

**Endpoints:** POST /v1/restriction-set-definition-versions, POST /v1/restriction-set-definition/{restriction\_set\_definition\_version.restriction\_set\_definition\_id}/versions

##### [](#request_174 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**restriction\_set\_definition\_version**  
  
object

 | 

The restriction set definition version to create. If the provided restriction set definition ID does not exist in the system, it will be created automatically. Required.

 |
| 

restriction\_set\_definition\_version.  
**restriction\_definitions\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

The restriction definitions that constitute this restriction set definition version. Required for create requests.

 |
| 

restriction\_set\_definition\_version.  
restriction\_definitions\[\].  
**restriction\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

The restriction type of this restriction definition. Required for create requests and must be unique among restriction definitions within a request and not set to unknown.  
  
**Enum values**  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown restriction type. There are no enforced combinations.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction type that prevents credits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from receiving credits  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from receiving credits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits using this payment device.  
  
**Optional argument**: `"prevent_credits_exemption_conditions"` Defines arbitrary key-value pairs, which, if they are all present in the `posting_instructions[].instruction_details` field of a Posting Instruction batch, will allow the restriction to be bypassed.  
  
This parameter must be formatted as a JSON string with one or more key-value pairs. For example, to prevent credits on an account except when the debtor account number is "1234", set the parameter to: `{"debtor_account_number":"1234"}`  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_REVIEW\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction type that will require reviewing credits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Forces a review of credits for an account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Forces a review of credits for a payment device.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that prevents debits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents debits for the customer.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents debits for the customer on a specific account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents debits for the account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents debits for the payment device.  
  
**Optional argument**: `"prevent_credits_exemption_conditions"` Defines arbitrary key-value pairs, which, if they are all present in the `posting_instructions[].instruction_details` field of a Posting Instruction batch, will allow the restriction to be bypassed.  
  
This parameter must be formatted as a JSON string with one or more key-value pairs. For example, to prevent credits on an account except when the debtor account number is "1234", set the parameter to: `{"debtor_account_number":"1234"}`  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_REVIEW\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that requires reviewing debits.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Forces a review of customer debits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Forces a review of account debits.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Forces a review of payment device debits.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_CLOSURE:**  
A restriction type that prevents closing a customer, account or payment device. Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents all stakeholders from closing the account.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from being made inactive.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_OPENING:**  
A restriction type that prevents opening a customer, account or payment device. Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents an account from being approved  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents a payment device from being made active  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction type that limits debits being made by a customer, account or payment device. Applies to individual posting amounts, not a cumulative amount across one or more postings.  
  
**Required arguments**: `limit_debits_amount` and `limit_debits_currency` must be included as part of `restriction_set_parameters` when creating a restriction set.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Limits the debits the customer can make to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER, RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Limits the debits the customer can make from an account to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Limits the debits the account can make to the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Limits the debits the payment device can make to the specified amount.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction type that limits credits for a customer, account or payment device. Applies to individual posting amounts, not a cumulative amount across one or more postings.  
  
**Required arguments**: `limit_credits_amount` and `limit_credits_currency` must be included as part of the `restriction_set_parameters` when creating a restriction set.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from receiving credits above the specified amount.  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_UPDATES:**  
A restriction type that prevents updating a customer, account or payment device.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]`: Prevents the account from being updated.  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_PAYMENT_DEVICE]`: Prevents the payment device from being updated.  
  
**Note**: `[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]` prevents account updates via [PUT /v1/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount) or [PUT /v2/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount). It does not prevent account updates via [POST /v1/account-updates](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_AccountUpdate_CreateAccountUpdate).  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_ACCOUNT\_CREATION:**  
A restriction type that prevents a customer from applying for any accounts, and from being added as a new stakeholder when updating an account. A stakeholder with a restriction of this type can be removed from the stakeholder list.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from applying for any accounts.  
  
  
**Default**  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

**Note**: `[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_ACCOUNT]` prevents account updates via [PUT /v1/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount) or [PUT /v2/accounts/{account.id}](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v2_accounts_Account_UpdateAccount). It does not prevent account updates via [POST /v1/account-updates](/vault-core/5-8/EN/api/core_api#_core_api_v1_accounts_AccountUpdate_CreateAccountUpdate).  
  
**RESTRICTION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_ACCOUNT\_CREATION:**  
A restriction type that prevents a customer from applying for any accounts, and from being added as a new stakeholder when updating an account. A stakeholder with a restriction of this type can be removed from the stakeholder list.  
  
Enforced restriction level combinations are:  
  
`[RESTRICTION_LEVEL_CUSTOMER]`: Prevents the customer from applying for any accounts.

## [](#scheduler "Copy link to heading")Scheduler

The Scheduler service is a Kafka-based service that automatically triggers Smart Contract and Workflow events, either at regular intervals or a singular point in time. A Smart Contract or Workflow is able to create scheduled events, known as \`schedules', to fulfil business logic.

Schedules have an active or inactive status, as determined by the Smart Contract or Workflow that created it. Each active schedule in Vault will publish triggers, known as \`Schedule jobs', for other components of Vault to execute or act upon.

chat\_bubble

See [Scheduler](/vault-core/5-8/EN/reference/scheduler/) for more information.

### [](#job "Copy link to heading")Job

#### [](#available_methods_69 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_scheduler_ListJobsResponse_ListJobs) Returns a list of Jobs based on a combination of filters including schedule IDs, Status, and Scheduled Timestamp window.
    
-   [Republish](#_google_protobuf_Empty_RepublishJob) Republishes a Job. **(Deprecated)**
    
-   [BatchGet](#_core_api_v1_scheduler_BatchGetJobsResponse_BatchGetJobs) Returns one or more Jobs.
    
-   [BatchRepublish](#_google_protobuf_Empty_BatchRepublishJobs) Republishes multiple Jobs.
    

#### [](#_core_api_v1_scheduler_ListJobsResponse_ListJobs "Copy link to heading")List

Returns a list of Jobs based on a combination of filters including schedule IDs, Status, and Scheduled Timestamp window.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.jobs:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/jobs

##### [](#request_176 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**schedule\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Schedule used to filter for associated Jobs. At least one of the schedule\_id or status fields must be populated.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.5**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*This field is deprecated in favour of the schedule\_ids field.*

 |
| 

**schedule\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

List of Schedule IDs used to filter for associated jobs. At least one of the schedule\_ids or status fields must be populated.  
  
Max length: 50 characters.

 |
| 

**status**  
  
enum

 | 

Filter for jobs that have this status. At least one of the schedule\_ids or status fields must be populated. Note: Filtering exclusively by `SUCCEEDED` status may result in timeouts due to the large amount of data returned. Use additional filters to limit the result set.  
  
**Enum values**  
**JOB\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value. A Job will never have this status.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_PUBLISHED:**  
A Job has been published but not executed.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_SUCCEEDED:**  
A Job has completed successfully.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_FAILED:**  
A Job has failed to complete. This will block further Jobs for the Schedule, as well as Schedules in the same Group, from running.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_SKIPPED:**  
If a Schedule has status SKIPPED, then the Jobs generated from it will be in this status. When the Schedule moves out of SKIPPED status the Job will be executed and its Status will change accordingly.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_OVERRIDDEN:**  
A Job that was in status JOB\_STATUS\_FAILED has been manually overridden via a POST /v1/jobs:batchRepublish request. A Job with this status will allow further Jobs for the Schedule to execute. Behaviour identical to JOB\_STATUS\_SUCCEEDED.  
  
**Default**  
**JOB\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

**from\_timestamp**  
  
string

 | 

Scheduled\_timestamp used to list all Jobs with a scheduled\_timestamp equal to or after this time. Optional.

 |
| 

**to\_timestamp**  
  
string

 | 

Scheduled\_timestamp used to list all Jobs with a scheduled\_timestamp equal to or before this time. Optional.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be listed.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 500.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, returns the results based on the other parameters. Optional.

 |

jobs\[KEY\].

jobs\[KEY\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The execution status of the Job.  
  
**Enum values**  
**JOB\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value. A Job will never have this status.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_PUBLISHED:**  
A Job has been published but not executed.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_SUCCEEDED:**  
A Job has completed successfully.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_FAILED:**  
A Job has failed to complete. This will block further Jobs for the Schedule, as well as Schedules in the same Group, from running.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_SKIPPED:**  
If a Schedule has status SKIPPED, then the Jobs generated from it will be in this status. When the Schedule moves out of SKIPPED status the Job will be executed and its Status will change accordingly.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_OVERRIDDEN:**  
A Job that was in status JOB\_STATUS\_FAILED has been manually overridden via a POST /v1/jobs:batchRepublish request. A Job with this status will allow further Jobs for the Schedule to execute. Behaviour identical to JOB\_STATUS\_SUCCEEDED.

#### [](#_google_protobuf_Empty_BatchRepublishJobs "Copy link to heading")BatchRepublish

Republishes multiple Jobs.

**Permission Scopes:** core:execute, core.jobs:execute

**Endpoint:** POST /v1/jobs:batchRepublish

##### [](#request_179 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of the Jobs to be republished.  
  
Required.  
Min count: 1.  
Max count: 500.

 |
| 

**target\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

This field must be omitted or set to JOB\_STATUS\_OVERRIDDEN. If set to JOB\_STATUS\_OVERRIDDEN then all the provided IDs must reference Jobs with status JOB\_STATUS\_FAILED. The Jobs will be republished, but execution will not be retried, meaning no new directives will be committed. When the Jobs update to JOB\_STATUS\_OVERRIDDEN, each Job’s Schedule will become unblocked.  
  
**Enum values**  
**JOB\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value. A Job will never have this status.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_PUBLISHED:**  
A Job has been published but not executed.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_SUCCEEDED:**  
A Job has completed successfully.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_FAILED:**  
A Job has failed to complete. This will block further Jobs for the Schedule, as well as Schedules in the same Group, from running.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_SKIPPED:**  
If a Schedule has status SKIPPED, then the Jobs generated from it will be in this status. When the Schedule moves out of SKIPPED status the Job will be executed and its Status will change accordingly.  
**JOB\_STATUS\_OVERRIDDEN:**  
A Job that was in status JOB\_STATUS\_FAILED has been manually overridden via a POST /v1/jobs:batchRepublish request. A Job with this status will allow further Jobs for the Schedule to execute. Behaviour identical to JOB\_STATUS\_SUCCEEDED.  
  
**Default**  
**JOB\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

 |

### [](#schedule "Copy link to heading")Schedule

#### [](#available_methods_70 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_core_api_v1_scheduler_ListSchedulesResponse_ListSchedules) Lists and filters Schedules.

#### [](#_core_api_v1_scheduler_ListSchedulesResponse_ListSchedules "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters Schedules.

**Permission Scopes:** core:read, core.schedules:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Best Effort

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/schedules

##### [](#request_180 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be listed. Required; must be non-zero.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 500.

 |
| 

**status**  
  
enum

 | 

+  
**Enum values**  
**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value - equivalent to unfiltered.  
**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_ENABLED:**  
The Schedule is enabled and active.  
**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
The Schedule is disabled and inactive.  
**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The Schedule has completed and is inactive.  
**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_FAILED:**  
The Schedule has failed and is inactive.  
**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
The Schedule is in a PENDING State.  
**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_DELAYED:**  
A Schedule is in a DELAYED State.  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.6**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*This status is now deprecated.*  
  
**Default**  
**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, returns the results based on the other parameters. Optional.

 |
| 

**name\_filter**  
  
string

 | 

Filter schedules by those whose name starts with this prefix. Cannot be used with resource filter. Optional.

 |
| 

**resource**  
  
object

 | 

Filter schedules by an associated resource. Cannot be used with status or name\_filter. Optional.

 |
| 

resource.  
**resource\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the resource that the schedules are associated to. Required if resource is being passed as a filter

 |
| 

resource.  
**resource\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of resource to be filtered for. Required if resource is being passed as a filter.  
  
**Enum values**  
**RESOURCE\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value, invalid.  
**RESOURCE\_TYPE\_ACCOUNT:**  
Resource type for accounts.  
**RESOURCE\_TYPE\_PLAN:**  
Resource type for plans.  
  
**Default**  
**RESOURCE\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

 |

**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_ENABLED:**

**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
The Schedule is disabled and inactive.  
**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**

**SCHEDULE\_STATUS\_FAILED:**
